title.zh: 卷五 魏本紀第五: 敬宗孝莊帝 節閔帝 廢帝 孝武帝 西魏文帝 西魏廢帝 西魏恭帝 東魏孝靜帝
title.en: Volume 5 Wei Annals 5: Emperor Jingzong Xiaozhuang, Emperor Jiemin, Deposed Emperor, Emperor Xiaowu, Emperor Wen of Western Wei, Deposed Emperor of Western Wei, Emperor Gong of Western Wei, Emperor Xiaojing of Eastern Wei
title.raw: 卷五 魏本紀第五: 敬宗孝莊帝 節閔帝 廢帝 孝武帝 西魏文帝 西魏廢帝 西魏恭帝 東魏孝靜帝 Volume 5 Wei Annals 5: Emperor Jingzong Xiaozhuang, Emperor Jiemin, Deposed Emperor, Emperor Xiaowu, Emperor Wen of Western Wei, Deposed Emperor of Western Wei, Emperor Gong of Western Wei, Emperor Xiaojing of Eastern Wei

sentences.zh: 敬宗孝莊帝

translations.literal: Emperor Jingzong Xiaozhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jingzong Xiaozhuang.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，車駕入宮，御太極殿。

translations.literal: On xinchou, the imperial carriage entered the palace and took seat in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Emperor entered the palace and took the throne in the Hall of Supreme Ultimate.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改武泰為建義元年。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and the era name Wutai was changed to Jianyi, year one.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the era name from Wutai to Jianyi, year one.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，榮表請追謚無上王為皇帝。

translations.literal: On renyin, Rong memorialized requesting posthumous ennoblement of the Prince Without Superior as emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Erzhu Rong memorialized asking that the late Prince Without Superior be given the posthumous title of emperor.

sentences.zh: 餘死河陰者，諸王、刺史贈三司，三品者令僕，五品者刺史，七品已下及庶人，郡、鎮。

translations.literal: For the rest who died at Heyin, princes and regional inspectors were granted posthumous ranks of the Three Excellencies; third-rank officials received ranks of ministers; fifth-rank officials received regional inspector rank; seventh rank and below together with commoners received commandery and garrison appointments.
translations.idiomatic: As for the others slain at Heyin, princes and prefects were posthumously honored as Three Excellencies, third-rank men as ministers, fifth-rank men as regional inspectors, and everyone from seventh rank down to commoners received appointments in commanderies and garrisons.

sentences.zh: 諸死者子孫，聽立後，授封爵。

translations.literal: The descendants of all the dead were permitted to establish heirs and were granted enfeoffments and noble ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of the dead were allowed to establish heirs and were granted titles of nobility.

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved it by edict.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以前太尉、江陽王繼為太師、司州牧。

translations.literal: On guimao, the former Grand Commandant, Prince of Jiangyang Ji, was made Grand Preceptor and Governor of Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the former Grand Commandant, Prince of Jiangyang Ji, was appointed Grand Preceptor and Governor of Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 相州刺史、北海王顥為太傅、開府，仍刺史。

translations.literal: Regional Inspector and Prince of Beihai Hao was made Grand Tutor with an opening office, and remained regional inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Beihai Hao, regional inspector, was made Grand Tutor with an opening office while retaining his inspectorship.

sentences.zh: 封光祿大夫、清泉縣侯李延實為陽平王，位太保，遷太傅；

translations.literal: Court Gentleman of the Luminous Office and Marquis of Qingquan Li Yanshi was enfeoffed as Prince of Yangping, appointed Grand Guardian, and promoted to Grand Tutor;
translations.idiomatic: Li Yanshi, Court Gentleman of the Luminous Office and Marquis of Qingquan, was enfeoffed as Prince of Yangping, made Grand Guardian, and then promoted to Grand Tutor;

sentences.zh: 以并州刺史元天穆為太尉，封上黨王。

translations.literal: and Bingzhou Regional Inspector Yuan Tianmu was made Grand Commandant and enfeoffed as Prince of Shangdang.
translations.idiomatic: and Bingzhou Regional Inspector Yuan Tianmu was made Grand Commandant and enfeoffed as Prince of Shangdang.

sentences.zh: 以儀同三司楊椿為司徒。

translations.literal: Yang Chun, Commissioner Equal to the Third Rank, was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Chun, Commissioner Equal to the Third Rank, was appointed Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 以儀同三司、頓丘郡公穆紹為司空，領尚書令，進爵為王。

translations.literal: Mu Shao, Commissioner Equal to the Third Rank and Duke of Dunqiu, was made Minister of Works, appointed Director of the Department of State Affairs, and advanced in noble rank to prince.
translations.idiomatic: Mu Shao, Commissioner Equal to the Third Rank and Duke of Dunqiu, was made Minister of Works and Director of the Department of State Affairs, and advanced to princely rank.

sentences.zh: 以雍州刺史長孫承業為開府儀同三司，進封馮翊王。

translations.literal: Changsun Chengye, Regional Inspector of Yongzhou, was made Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank and advanced to Prince of Fengyi.
translations.idiomatic: Changsun Chengye, Regional Inspector of Yongzhou, was made Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank and promoted to Prince of Fengyi.

sentences.zh: 以殿中尚書元諶為尚書右僕射，封魏郡王。

translations.literal: Yuan Chen, Director in the Palace Secretariat, was made Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and enfeoffed as Prince of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Chen, Director in the Palace Secretariat, was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and enfeoffed as Prince of Wei.

sentences.zh: 以給事黃門侍郎元填為東海王。

translations.literal: Yuan Tian, Attendant Gentleman at the Yellow Gate, was enfeoffed as Prince of Donghai.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Tian, Attendant Gentleman at the Yellow Gate, received the title Prince of Donghai.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以敷城王坦為咸陽王。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Prince of Fucheng Tan was made Prince of Xianyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Prince of Fucheng Tan was made Prince of Xianyang.

sentences.zh: 以諫議大夫元貴平為東萊王。

translations.literal: Remonstrating and Consulting Grandee Yuan Guiping was made Prince of Donglai.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrating and Consulting Grandee Yuan Guiping was enfeoffed as Prince of Donglai.

sentences.zh: 以直閣將軍元肅為魯郡王。

translations.literal: Direct Attendant General Yuan Su was made Prince of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: Direct Attendant General Yuan Su was enfeoffed as Prince of Lu.

sentences.zh: 以秘書郎中元曄為長廣王。

translations.literal: Secretariat Gentleman Yuan Ye was made Prince of Changguang.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat Gentleman Yuan Ye was enfeoffed as Prince of Changguang.

sentences.zh: 以馮翊郡公源紹景復先爵隴西王。

translations.literal: Yuan Shaojing, Duke of Fengyi, was restored to his former enfeoffment as Prince of Longxi.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Shaojing, Duke of Fengyi, was restored to his former title as Prince of Longxi.

sentences.zh: 扶風郡公馮冏、東郡公陸子彰、北平公長孫悅並復先王爵。

translations.literal: Feng Tong, Duke of Fufeng; Lu Zizhang, Duke of Dongjun; and Changsun Yue, Duke of Beiping, all had their former princely titles restored.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Tong of Fufeng, Lu Zizhang of Dongjun, and Changsun Yue of Beiping all had their ancestral princely ranks restored.

sentences.zh: 以北平王超還復為安定王。

translations.literal: Prince of Beiping Chao was returned to his former title as Prince of Anding.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Beiping Chao was restored to his former title as Prince of Anding.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔中外解嚴。

translations.literal: On dingwei, an edict lifted martial law throughout court and country.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day an edict ended martial law at court and in the realm.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，封大將軍爾朱榮次子義羅為梁郡王。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Erzhu Rong's second son Yiluo, Grand General, was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day Yiluo, second son of Grand General Erzhu Rong, was enfeoffed as Prince of Liang.

sentences.zh: 詔蠕蠕王阿那瑰贊拜不名，上書不稱臣。

translations.literal: An edict granted the Rouran king Anagui the privilege of bowing without having his name called and of submitting memorials without styling himself subject.
translations.idiomatic: By edict the Rouran king Anagui was granted the privilege of bowing without having his name called and of addressing the throne without calling himself a subject.

sentences.zh: 是月，汝南王悅、北海王顥、臨淮王彧前後奔梁。

translations.literal: That month, Prince of Runan Yue, Prince of Beihai Hao, and Prince of Huaiyang Yu successively fled to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: That month Prince of Runan Yue, Prince of Beihai Hao, and Prince of Huaiyang Yu fled to Liang one after another.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳朔，以右僕射元羅為東道大使，光祿勛元欣副之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month, dingsi, Right Vice Director Yuan Luo was made Eastern Circuit Grand Ambassador, with Court Gentleman of the Luminous Office Yuan Xin as his deputy.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the first day of the fifth month, Right Vice Director Yuan Luo was made Grand Ambassador of the Eastern Circuit, with Court Gentleman Yuan Xin as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 循方黜陟，先行後聞。

translations.literal: He was to tour the regions, dismiss and promote officials, and act first and report afterward.
translations.idiomatic: He was to tour the circuits, dismiss and promote officials, and act first and report afterward.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，大將軍爾朱榮還晉陽，帝餞於邙陰。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Grand General Erzhu Rong returned to Jinyang; the Emperor gave him a farewell feast on the northern slope of Mount Mang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Grand General Erzhu Rong returned to Jinyang, and the Emperor gave him a farewell feast on the northern slope of Mount Mang.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯，以高昌王世子光為平西將軍、瓜州刺史，襲爵泰臨縣伯、高昌王。

translations.literal: On guimao in the sixth month, Guang, heir of the King of Gaochang, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Regional Inspector of Guazhou, inheriting the rank of Count of Tailin and the title King of Gaochang.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the sixth month Guang, heir of the King of Gaochang, was made General Who Pacifies the West and Regional Inspector of Guazhou, inheriting the rank of Count of Tailin and the title King of Gaochang.

sentences.zh: 帝以寇難未夷，避正殿，責躬撤膳。

translations.literal: Because rebellion had not yet been quelled, the Emperor avoided the main hall, blamed himself, and withdrew from full meals.
translations.idiomatic: Because the realm was still unsettled, the Emperor avoided the main hall, blamed himself, and took only frugal meals.

sentences.zh: 又班募格，收集忠勇。

translations.literal: He also issued recruitment regulations to gather the loyal and brave.
translations.idiomatic: He also issued recruitment regulations to gather loyal and courageous men.

sentences.zh: 有直言正諫之士者，集華林園，面論時事。

translations.literal: Men who spoke bluntly and remonstrated were assembled in the Hualin Garden to discuss current affairs face to face.
translations.idiomatic: Men who spoke frankly and offered remonstrance were gathered in the Hualin Garden to debate affairs of state face to face.

sentences.zh: 幽州平北府主簿河間邢杲率河北流移人萬餘戶，反於北海，自署漢王，年號天統。

translations.literal: Xing Guo, clerk of the Pingbei Office in Youzhou from Hejian, led more than ten thousand households of displaced people from north of the Yellow River in revolt at Beihai, styled himself King of Han, and adopted the era name Tiantong.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Guo, a clerk of the Pingbei Office in Youzhou from Hejian, led more than ten thousand displaced households from north of the Yellow River in revolt at Beihai, declared himself King of Han, and adopted the era name Tiantong.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙丑，加大將軍爾朱榮柱國大將軍、錄尚書事。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on yichou, Grand General Erzhu Rong was promoted to Pillar of State, Grand General, and Recorder of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on yichou day, Grand General Erzhu Rong was promoted to Pillar of State, Grand General, and Recorder of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬子，光州人劉舉聚眾反於濮陽，自稱皇武大將。

translations.literal: On renzi, Liu Ju of Guangzhou gathered a crowd in revolt at Puyang and styled himself Grand General of August Martiality.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Liu Ju of Guangzhou raised a crowd in revolt at Puyang and styled himself Grand General of August Martiality.

sentences.zh: 是月，高平鎮人万俟醜奴僭稱大位。

translations.literal: That month, Wan Qichou of Gaochang Garrison usurped the supreme position.
translations.idiomatic: That month Wan Qichou of Gaochang Garrison usurped imperial rank.

sentences.zh: 臨淮王彧自江南還朝。

translations.literal: Prince of Huaiyang Yu returned to court from south of the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Huaiyang Yu returned to court from the lands south of the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 八月，太山太守羊侃據郡反。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Yang Kan, Regional Administrator of Taishan, seized the commandery in revolt.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Yang Kan, Regional Administrator of Taishan, seized the commandery and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔大都督宗正珍孫討劉舉。

translations.literal: On jiachen, an edict ordered Grand Commander Zongzheng Zhensun to campaign against Liu Ju.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day an edict ordered Grand Commander Zongzheng Zhensun to campaign against Liu Ju.

sentences.zh: 平之。

translations.literal: He pacified the rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: He pacified them.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，以齊州刺史元欣為沛郡王。

translations.literal: On jisi in the ninth month, Yuan Xin, Regional Inspector of Qi, was made Prince of Pei.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi in the ninth month Yuan Xin, Regional Inspector of Qi, was enfeoffed as Prince of Pei.

sentences.zh: 壬申，柱國大將軍爾朱榮率騎七千討葛榮於滏口，破禽之。

translations.literal: On renshen, Pillar of State and Grand General Erzhu Rong led seven thousand horsemen to campaign against Ge Rong at Fukou, defeated him, and captured him alive.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Pillar of State and Grand General Erzhu Rong led seven thousand horsemen against Ge Rong at Fukou, defeated him, and took him alive.

sentences.zh: 冀、定、滄、瀛、殷五州平。

translations.literal: The five provinces of Ji, Ding, Cang, Ying, and Yin were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The five provinces of Ji, Ding, Cang, Ying, and Yin were pacified.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以葛榮平，大赦，改元為永安。

translations.literal: On yihai, because Ge Rong had been pacified, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Yongan.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day, because Ge Rong had been pacified, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed to Yongan.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以爾朱榮為大丞相，進榮子平昌郡公文殊、昌樂郡公文暢爵並為王。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Erzhu Rong was made Grand Chancellor; Rong's sons Wenshu, Duke of Pingchang, and Wenchang, Duke of Changle, were both advanced in noble rank to prince.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Erzhu Rong was made Grand Chancellor, and his sons Wenshu, Duke of Pingchang, and Wenchang, Duke of Changle, were both raised to princely rank.

sentences.zh: 以司徒楊椿為太保，城陽王徽為司徒。

translations.literal: Minister over the Masses Yang Chun was made Grand Guardian, and Prince of Chengyang Hui was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Chun, Minister over the Masses, was made Grand Guardian, and Prince of Chengyang Hui was made Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁亥，爾朱榮檻送葛榮於京師。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, on dinghai, Erzhu Rong sent Ge Rong to the capital in a caged cart.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on dinghai day, Erzhu Rong sent Ge Rong to the capital in a caged cart.

sentences.zh: 帝臨閶闔門，榮稽顙謝罪，斬於都市。

translations.literal: The Emperor came to the Gate of Opening the Gate to All Directions; Rong kowtowed in confession of guilt, and Ge Rong was beheaded in the market.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor came to the Gate of Opening the Gate to All Directions; Rong kowtowed in confession of guilt, and Ge Rong was beheaded in the market.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，江陽王繼薨。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Prince of Jiangyang Ji died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Prince of Jiangyang Ji died.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，復膠東縣侯李侃希祖爵南郡王。

translations.literal: On guichou, Marquis of Jiaodong Li Kanxi was restored to his ancestral enfeoffment as Prince of Nan.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Marquis of Jiaodong Li Kanxi was restored to his ancestral title as Prince of Nan.

sentences.zh: 是月，大都督費穆大破梁軍。

translations.literal: That month, Grand Commander Fei Mu inflicted a great defeat on the Liang army.
translations.idiomatic: That month Grand Commander Fei Mu inflicted a great defeat on the Liang army.

sentences.zh: 禽其將曹義宗，檻送京師。

translations.literal: He captured their general Cao Yizong and sent him to the capital in a caged cart.
translations.idiomatic: He captured their general Cao Yizong and sent him to the capital in a caged cart.

sentences.zh: 梁以北海王顥為魏主，年號孝基，入據南兗之铚城。

translations.literal: Liang installed Prince of Beihai Hao as ruler of Wei, with the era name Xiaoji, and he entered and seized Cheng City in southern Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Liang installed Prince of Beihai Hao as ruler of Wei under the era name Xiaoji, and he entered and seized Cheng City in southern Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，以無上王世子韶為彭城王；

translations.literal: On wuwu, Shao, heir of the Prince Without Superior, was made Prince of Pengcheng;
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Shao, heir of the Prince Without Superior, was made Prince of Pengcheng;

sentences.zh: 陳留王子寬為陳留王；

translations.literal: Zikuan, son of Prince of Chenliu, was made Prince of Chenliu;
translations.idiomatic: Zikuan, son of Prince of Chenliu, was made Prince of Chenliu;

sentences.zh: 寬弟剛為浮陽王；

translations.literal: Zikuan's younger brother Gang was made Prince of Fuyang;
translations.idiomatic: Zikuan's younger brother Gang was made Prince of Fuyang;

sentences.zh: 剛弟質為林慮王。

translations.literal: and Gang's younger brother Zhi was made Prince of Linyu.
translations.idiomatic: and Gang's younger brother Zhi was made Prince of Linyu.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，行臺于暉等大破羊侃於瑕丘。

translations.literal: On guihai, Yu Hui of the Mobile Secretariat and others inflicted a great defeat on Yang Kan at Xiaqiu.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Yu Hui of the Mobile Secretariat and others inflicted a great defeat on Yang Kan at Xiaqiu.

sentences.zh: 侃奔梁。

translations.literal: Kan fled to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Kan fled to Liang.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，封前軍元凝為東安王。

translations.literal: On wuyin, former Front Army Yuan Ning was enfeoffed as Prince of Dong'an.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day former Front Army Yuan Ning was enfeoffed as Prince of Dong'an.

sentences.zh: 是歲，葛榮餘黨韓樓復據幽州反。

translations.literal: That year, Han Lou, a remnant follower of Ge Rong, again seized Youzhou in revolt.
translations.idiomatic: That year Han Lou, a remnant of Ge Rong's forces, again seized Youzhou and rebelled.

sentences.zh: 二年春二月甲午，追尊皇考為文穆皇帝，廟號肅祖。

translations.literal: In the second year, spring, second month, on jiawu, the late Emperor, the Emperor's father, was posthumously honored as Emperor Wenmu, with temple name Suzu.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of the second year, second month, on jiawu day the late Emperor, the Emperor's father, was posthumously honored as Emperor Wenmu with temple name Suzu.

sentences.zh: 皇妣為文穆皇后。

translations.literal: The late Empress, the Emperor's mother, was posthumously honored as Empress Wenmu.
translations.idiomatic: The late Empress, the Emperor's mother, was posthumously honored as Empress Wenmu.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸未，遷文穆皇帝及文穆皇后神主於太廟，降畿內死罪已下刑。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on guiwei, the spirit tablets of Emperor Wenmu and Empress Wenmu were moved to the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and capital punishment and below within the metropolitan circuit were reduced one degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guiwei day, the spirit tablets of Emperor Wenmu and Empress Wenmu were moved to the Imperial Ancestral Temple, and capital sentences and below within the metropolitan circuit were commuted one degree.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，上黨王天穆大破邢杲於濟南。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Prince of Shangdang Tianmu inflicted a great defeat on Xing Guo at Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day Prince of Shangdang Tianmu inflicted a great defeat on Xing Guo at Jinan.

sentences.zh: 杲降，送於京師，斬於都市。

translations.literal: Guo surrendered and was sent to the capital, where he was beheaded in the market.
translations.idiomatic: Guo surrendered and was sent to the capital, where he was beheaded in the market.

sentences.zh: 五月壬子朔，元顥克梁國。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month, renzi, Yuan Hao captured Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, the first day of the fifth month, Yuan Hao captured Liang.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: On yichou, martial law was imposed within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day martial law was imposed at court and in the realm.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，元顥陷滎陽。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Yuan Hao took Xingyang.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Yuan Hao took Xingyang.

sentences.zh: 甲戌夜，車駕北巡。

translations.literal: On the night of jiaxu, the imperial carriage made a northern tour.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jiaxu day the Emperor made a northern tour.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，幸河內。

translations.literal: On yihai, he arrived at Henei.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day he arrived at Henei.

sentences.zh: 丙子，元顥入洛。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Yuan Hao entered Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Yuan Hao entered Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，進封城陽縣公元祉為平原王；

translations.literal: On dingchou, Yuan Zhi, Count of Chengyang, was advanced to Prince of Pingyuan;
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Yuan Zhi, Count of Chengyang, was advanced to Prince of Pingyuan;

sentences.zh: 安昌縣公元鷙為華山王。

translations.literal: and Yuan Zhi, Count of Anchang, was advanced to Prince of Huashan.
translations.idiomatic: and Yuan Zhi, Count of Anchang, was advanced to Prince of Huashan.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，太原王爾朱榮會車駕於長子，即日反旆。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Prince of Taiyuan Erzhu Rong joined the imperial carriage at Changzi and turned the army about that same day.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Prince of Taiyuan Erzhu Rong joined the imperial carriage at Changzi and turned the army about that same day.

sentences.zh: 上黨王天穆北渡，會車駕於河內。

translations.literal: Prince of Shangdang Tianmu crossed north and joined the imperial carriage at Henei.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Shangdang Tianmu crossed north and joined the imperial carriage at Henei.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，都督爾朱兆、賀拔勝從硤石夜濟。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuchen, Area Commanders Erzhu Zhao and Heba Sheng crossed from Xiashi by night.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuchen day Area Commanders Erzhu Zhao and Heba Sheng crossed from Xiashi by night.

sentences.zh: 破顥子冠受及安豐王延明軍。

translations.literal: They defeated the armies of Hao's son Guanshou and Prince of Anfeng Yanming.
translations.idiomatic: They defeated the armies of Hao's son Guanshou and Prince of Anfeng Yanming.

sentences.zh: 元顥敗走。

translations.literal: Yuan Hao was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Hao was defeated and fled.

sentences.zh: 庚午，車駕入居華林園，升大夏門大赦。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the imperial carriage entered and took up residence in the Hualin Garden, ascended the Gate of Great Summer, and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day the Emperor entered and took up residence in the Hualin Garden, ascended the Gate of Great Summer, and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以柱國大將軍、太原王爾朱榮為天柱大將軍。

translations.literal: On renshen, Pillar of State and Grand General Prince of Taiyuan Erzhu Rong was made Pillar of Heaven, Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Pillar of State and Grand General Prince of Taiyuan Erzhu Rong was made Pillar of Heaven, Grand General.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，臨潁縣卒江豐斬元顥，傳首京師。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Jiang Feng, a soldier of Linying County, beheaded Yuan Hao and sent his head to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Jiang Feng, a soldier of Linying County, beheaded Yuan Hao and sent his head to the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以大將軍、上黨王天穆為太宰，以司徒、城陽王徽為大司馬、太尉。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Grand General and Prince of Shangdang Tianmu was made Grand Preceptor, and Minister over the Masses and Prince of Chengyang Hui was made Grand Marshal and Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Grand General and Prince of Shangdang Tianmu was made Grand Preceptor, and Minister over the Masses and Prince of Chengyang Hui was made Grand Marshal and Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以南青州刺史元旭為襄城王；

translations.literal: On jimao, Yuan Xu, Regional Inspector of Southern Qing, was made Prince of Xiangcheng;
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day Yuan Xu, Regional Inspector of Southern Qing, was made Prince of Xiangcheng;

sentences.zh: 南兗州刺史元暹為汝陽王。

translations.literal: and Yuan Xian, Regional Inspector of Southern Yan, was made Prince of Ruyang.
translations.idiomatic: and Yuan Xian, Regional Inspector of Southern Yan, was made Prince of Ruyang.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛巳，帝始居宮內。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on xinsi, the Emperor first took up residence within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on xinsi day, the Emperor first took up residence within the palace.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以兼吏部尚書楊津為司空。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Yang Jin, Acting Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Yang Jin, Acting Director of the Ministry of Personnel, was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 八月己未，以太傅李延實為司徒。

translations.literal: On jiwei in the eighth month, Grand Tutor Li Yanshi was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the eighth month Grand Tutor Li Yanshi was made Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，封瓜州刺史元太宗為東陽王。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Yuan Taizong, Regional Inspector of Guazhou, was enfeoffed as Prince of Dongyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Yuan Taizong, Regional Inspector of Guazhou, was enfeoffed as Prince of Dongyang.

sentences.zh: 九月，大都督侯深破韓樓於薊，斬之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Grand Commander Hou Shen defeated Han Lou at Ji and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Grand Commander Hou Shen defeated Han Lou at Ji and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 幽州平。

translations.literal: Youzhou was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou was pacified.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己酉朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the first day, jiyou, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiyou, the first day of the month, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以前司空、丹楊王蕭贊為司徒。

translations.literal: On dingchou, former Minister of Works and Prince of Danyang Xiao Zan was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day former Minister of Works and Prince of Danyang Xiao Zan was made Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 十一月己卯，就德興自榮州遣使請降。

translations.literal: On jimao in the eleventh month, Qiudexing of Rongzhou sent envoys requesting surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the eleventh month Qiudexing of Rongzhou sent envoys requesting surrender.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以大司馬、太尉、城陽王徽為太保，以司徒、丹楊王蕭贊為太尉，以雍州刺史長孫承業為司徒。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Grand Marshal, Grand Commandant, and Prince of Chengyang Hui was made Grand Guardian; Minister over the Masses and Prince of Danyang Xiao Zan was made Grand Commandant; and Regional Inspector of Yongzhou Changsun Chengye was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Grand Marshal and Grand Commandant Prince of Chengyang Hui was made Grand Guardian; Minister over the Masses and Prince of Danyang Xiao Zan was made Grand Commandant; and Regional Inspector of Yongzhou Changsun Chengye was made Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 三年夏四月丁卯，雍州刺史爾朱天光討万俟醜奴、蕭寶夤於安定。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the third year, on dingmao, Erzhu Tianguang, Regional Inspector of Yongzhou, campaigned against Wan Qichou and Xiao Baoyin at Anding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer of the third year, on dingmao day Erzhu Tianguang, Regional Inspector of Yongzhou, campaigned against Wan Qichou and Xiao Baoyin at Anding.

sentences.zh: 破禽之，囚送京師。

translations.literal: He defeated and captured them and sent them as prisoners to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated and captured them and sent them as prisoners to the capital.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以關中平，大赦。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, because Guanzhong had been pacified, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day, because Guanzhong had been pacified, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 斬醜奴於都市，賜寶夤死。

translations.literal: Wan Qichou was beheaded in the market, and Baoyin was granted death by suicide.
translations.idiomatic: Wan Qichou was beheaded in the market, and Baoyin was granted death by suicide.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午，嚈噠國獻師子一。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on wuwu, the Yanda state presented one lion.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuwu day, the Yanda state presented a lion.

sentences.zh: 是月，白馬龍泗胡王慶雲僭稱帝號於永洛城。

translations.literal: That month, Qingyun, King of the White Horse and Longsi Hu, usurped an imperial title at Yongluo City.
translations.idiomatic: That month Qingyun, King of the White Horse and Longsi Hu, usurped an imperial title at Yongluo City.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙子，爾朱天光平水洛城，禽慶雲。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingzi, Erzhu Tianguang pacified Yongluo City and captured Qingyun.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on bingzi day Erzhu Tianguang pacified Yongluo City and captured Qingyun.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，天柱大將軍爾朱榮、上黨王天穆自晉陽來朝。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on xinmao, Pillar of Heaven Grand General Erzhu Rong and Prince of Shangdang Tianmu came to court from Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinmao day Pillar of Heaven Grand General Erzhu Rong and Prince of Shangdang Tianmu came to court from Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，帝殺榮、天穆於明光殿，及榮子菩提。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the Emperor killed Rong and Tianmu in the Hall of Illuminated Glory, together with Rong's son Puti.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the Emperor killed Rong and Tianmu in the Hall of Illuminated Glory, together with Rong's son Puti.

sentences.zh: 乃升閶闔門，大赦。

translations.literal: He then ascended the Gate of Opening the Gate to All Directions and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: He then ascended the Gate of Opening the Gate to All Directions and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 遣武衛將軍奚毅、前燕州刺史侯深率眾鎮北中。

translations.literal: Martial Guard General Xi Yi and former Regional Inspector of Yan Hou Shen were dispatched to lead troops and garrison Beizhong.
translations.idiomatic: Martial Guard General Xi Yi and former Regional Inspector of Yan Hou Shen were dispatched to lead troops and garrison Beizhong.

sentences.zh: 是夜，左僕射爾朱世隆、榮妻鄉郡長公主率榮部曲，自西陽門出屯河陰。

translations.literal: That night, Left Vice Director Erzhu Shilong and Rong's wife, the Princess of Xiangjun, led Rong's troops out through the Xiyang Gate and encamped at Heyin.
translations.idiomatic: That night Left Vice Director Erzhu Shilong and Rong's wife, the Princess of Xiangjun, led Rong's troops out through the Xiyang Gate and encamped at Heyin.

sentences.zh: 己亥，攻河橋，禽毅等，屠害之。

translations.literal: On jihai, they attacked Heqiao, captured Yi and the others, and slaughtered them.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day they attacked Heqiao, captured Yi and the others, and slaughtered them.

sentences.zh: 據北中城，南逼京師。

translations.literal: They seized Beizhong City and pressed south toward the capital.
translations.idiomatic: They seized Beizhong City and pressed south toward the capital.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸卯朔，封大鴻臚卿寶炬為南陽王，汝陽縣公修為平陽王，新陽伯誕為昌樂王，瑯邪公昶為太原王。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the first day, guimao, Court Grandee Bao Ju was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanyang; Xiu, Duke of Ruyang, as Prince of Pingyang; Yan, Earl of Xinyang, as Prince of Changle; and Chang, Duke of Langye, as Prince of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guimao, the first day of the month, Court Grandee Bao Ju was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanyang; Xiu, Duke of Ruyang, as Prince of Pingyang; Yan, Earl of Xinyang, as Prince of Changle; and Chang, Duke of Langye, as Prince of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，徙封魏郡王諶為趙郡王，諶弟子趙郡王宣為平昌王。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Prince of Wei Yuan Chen was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao; Chen's nephew Xuan, Prince of Zhao, was made Prince of Pingchang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Prince of Wei Yuan Chen was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao; Chen's nephew Xuan, Prince of Zhao, was made Prince of Pingchang.

sentences.zh: 戊申，皇子生，大赦。

translations.literal: On wushen, a prince was born, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day a prince was born, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，通直散騎常侍李苗以火船焚河橋，爾朱世隆退走。

translations.literal: On yimao, Palace Attendant Li Miao burned Heqiao with fire ships, and Erzhu Shilong retreated.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Palace Attendant Li Miao burned Heqiao with fire ships, and Erzhu Shilong retreated.

sentences.zh: 壬申，世隆停建興之高都，爾朱兆自晉陽來會之，共推長廣王曄為主。

translations.literal: On renshen, Shilong halted at Gaodu in Jianxing; Erzhu Zhao came from Jinyang to join him, and together they installed Prince of Changguang Ye as ruler.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Shilong halted at Gaodu in Jianxing; Erzhu Zhao came from Jinyang to join him, and together they installed Prince of Changguang Ye as ruler.

sentences.zh: 大赦所部，年號建明。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed in their territory, with the era name Jianming.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed in their territory, with the era name Jianming.

sentences.zh: 徐州刺史爾朱仲遠反，率眾向京師。

translations.literal: Erzhu Zhongyuan, Regional Inspector of Xuzhou, rebelled and led troops toward the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu Zhongyuan, Regional Inspector of Xuzhou, rebelled and led troops toward the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙亥，以司徒長孫承業為太尉，以臨淮王彧為司徒。

translations.literal: On yihai in the eleventh month, Minister over the Masses Changsun Chengye was made Grand Commandant, and Prince of Huaiyang Yu was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the eleventh month Minister over the Masses Changsun Chengye was made Grand Commandant, and Prince of Huaiyang Yu was made Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 丙子，進雍州刺史、廣宗郡公爾朱天光爵為王。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Erzhu Tianguang, Regional Inspector of Yongzhou and Duke of Guangzong, was advanced in noble rank to prince.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Erzhu Tianguang, Regional Inspector of Yongzhou and Duke of Guangzong, was advanced to princely rank.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲辰，爾朱兆、爾朱度律自富平津上，率騎涉度以襲京城。

translations.literal: On jiachen in the twelfth month, Erzhu Zhao and Erzhu Dulü crossed from Fuping Ford and led horsemen wading the ford to strike the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the twelfth month Erzhu Zhao and Erzhu Dulü crossed from Fuping Ford and led horsemen wading the ford to strike the capital.

sentences.zh: 事出倉卒，禁衛不守。

translations.literal: The affair came suddenly, and the palace guard could not hold.
translations.idiomatic: The affair came suddenly, and the palace guard could not hold.

sentences.zh: 帝步出雲龍門。

translations.literal: The Emperor walked out through the Gate of Cloud Dragon.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor walked out through the Gate of Cloud Dragon.

sentences.zh: 兆逼帝幸永寧寺，殺皇子。

translations.literal: Zhao compelled the Emperor to go to Yongning Monastery and killed the princes.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao compelled the Emperor to go to Yongning Monastery and killed the princes.

sentences.zh: 亂兵殺司徒臨淮王彧、左僕射范陽王誨。

translations.literal: In the disorder troops killed Minister over the Masses and Prince of Huaiyang Yu and Left Vice Director and Prince of Fanyang Hui.
translations.idiomatic: In the disorder troops killed Minister over the Masses and Prince of Huaiyang Yu and Left Vice Director and Prince of Fanyang Hui.

sentences.zh: 戊申，爾朱度律自鎮京師。

translations.literal: On wushen, Erzhu Dulü garrisoned the capital from his post.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Erzhu Dulü garrisoned the capital from his post.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，爾朱兆遷帝於晉陽。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Erzhu Zhao moved the Emperor to Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Erzhu Zhao moved the Emperor to Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 甲子，帝遇弒於城內三級佛寺，時年二十四。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the Emperor was assassinated in the Three-Tier Buddhist Monastery within the city, aged twenty-four.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day the Emperor was assassinated in the Three-Tier Buddhist Monastery within the city, aged twenty-four.

sentences.zh: 並害陳留王寬。

translations.literal: Prince of Chenliu Kuan was also killed.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Chenliu Kuan was also killed.

sentences.zh: 中興二年，廢帝奉謚為武懷皇帝。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhongxing, the Deposed Emperor posthumously honored him as Emperor Wuhuai.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhongxing the Deposed Emperor posthumously honored him as Emperor Wuhuai.

sentences.zh: 及孝武立，又以廟諱故，改謚孝莊皇帝，廟號敬宗。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu acceded, because of taboo on the temple name, the posthumous title was changed to Emperor Xiaozhuang, with temple name Jingzong.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu acceded, because of taboo on the temple name, the posthumous title was changed to Emperor Xiaozhuang, with temple name Jingzong.

sentences.zh: 葬靜陵。

translations.literal: He was buried at Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: He was buried at Jingling.

sentences.zh: 節閔帝

translations.literal: Emperor Jiemin.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jiemin.

sentences.zh: 節閔皇帝諱恭，字修業，廣陵惠王羽之子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Jiemin, taboo name Gong, style name Xiuye, was a son of Prince of Guangling Hui.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Jiemin, taboo name Gong, style name Xiuye, was a son of Prince of Guangling Hui.

sentences.zh: 母曰王氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Lady Wang.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Lady Wang.

sentences.zh: 帝少有誌度，事祖母、嫡母以孝聞。

translations.literal: In youth the Emperor had resolve and measure; he was known for filial service to his grandmother and principal mother.
translations.idiomatic: In youth the Emperor had resolve and measure; he was known for filial service to his grandmother and principal mother.

sentences.zh: 正始中，襲爵。

translations.literal: In the Zhengshi era he inherited the enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhengshi era he inherited the enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 位給事黃門侍郎。

translations.literal: He held the post of Attendant Gentleman at the Yellow Gate.
translations.idiomatic: He held the post of Attendant Gentleman at the Yellow Gate.

sentences.zh: 帝以元叉擅權，托稱喑病，絕言垂一紀。

translations.literal: Because Yuan Cha monopolized power, the Emperor feigned muteness and illness and ceased speech for nearly twelve years.
translations.idiomatic: Because Yuan Cha monopolized power, the Emperor feigned muteness and illness and ceased speech for nearly twelve years.

sentences.zh: 居於龍花佛寺，無所交通。

translations.literal: He dwelt at Longhua Buddhist Monastery and had no social dealings.
translations.idiomatic: He dwelt at Longhua Buddhist Monastery and had no social dealings.

sentences.zh: 永安末，有白莊帝，言帝不語，將有異圖。

translations.literal: At the end of Yongan someone reported to Emperor Zhuang, saying the Emperor did not speak and harbored unusual designs.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Yongan someone reported to Emperor Zhuang, saying the Emperor did not speak and harbored unusual designs.

sentences.zh: 人間遊聲，又云常有天子氣。

translations.literal: Rumors among the people also said that imperial aura was often seen about him.
translations.idiomatic: Rumors among the people also said that imperial aura was often seen about him.

sentences.zh: 帝懼禍，遂逃匿上洛。

translations.literal: Fearing disaster, he fled and hid at Shangluo.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing disaster, he fled and hid at Shangluo.

sentences.zh: 尋見追躡，送京師，拘禁多日，以無狀獲免。

translations.literal: Soon he was pursued and captured, sent to the capital, and detained many days before being released for lack of evidence.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was pursued and captured, sent to the capital, and detained many days before being released for lack of evidence.

sentences.zh: 及莊帝崩，爾朱世隆等以元曄疏遠，又非人望所推，以帝有過人之量，將謀廢立。

translations.literal: When Emperor Zhuang died, Erzhu Shilong and others, because Yuan Ye was remote in kinship and not what men looked to, considered the Emperor's surpassing capacity and planned to depose and install.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Zhuang died, Erzhu Shilong and others, because Yuan Ye was remote in kinship and not what men looked to, considered the Emperor's surpassing capacity and planned to depose and install.

sentences.zh: 恐實不語，乃令帝所親申意，兼迫脅。

translations.literal: Fearing he truly did not speak, they had those close to him convey their intent and also applied coercion.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing he truly did not speak, they had those close to him convey their intent and also applied coercion.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「天何言哉。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Heaven—what does it say?"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "Heaven—what does it say?"

sentences.zh: 」世隆等大悅。

translations.literal: Shilong and the others were greatly pleased.
translations.idiomatic: Shilong and the others were greatly pleased.

sentences.zh: 及元曄至邙南，世隆等奉帝東郭外，行禪讓禮。

translations.literal: When Yuan Ye reached the southern slope of Mount Mang, Shilong and others received the Emperor outside the eastern gate and performed the ceremony of yielding the throne.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Ye reached the southern slope of Mount Mang, Shilong and others received the Emperor outside the eastern gate and performed the ceremony of yielding the throne.

sentences.zh: 太尉爾朱度律奉路車，進璽紱。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant Erzhu Dulü presented the imperial carriage and advanced the seal and cord.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant Erzhu Dulü presented the imperial carriage and advanced the seal and cord.

sentences.zh: 服袞冕，百官侍衛，入自建春、雲龍門。

translations.literal: He donned the imperial robes and cap; officials attended in guard; he entered through the Jianchun and Cloud Dragon gates.
translations.idiomatic: He donned the imperial robes and cap; officials attended in guard; he entered through the Jianchun and Cloud Dragon gates.

sentences.zh: 三月癸酉，封長廣王曄為東海王。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guiyou, Prince of Changguang Ye was enfeoffed as Prince of Donghai.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guiyou day Prince of Changguang Ye was enfeoffed as Prince of Donghai.

sentences.zh: 以青州刺史、魯郡王肅為太師。

translations.literal: Prince of Lu Yuan Su, Regional Inspector of Qing, was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Lu Yuan Su, Regional Inspector of Qing, was made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 沛郡王欣為太傅、司州牧，改封淮陽王。

translations.literal: Prince of Pei Xin was made Grand Tutor and Governor of Sizhou, and his title was changed to Prince of Huaiyang.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Pei Xin was made Grand Tutor and Governor of Sizhou, and his title was changed to Prince of Huaiyang.

sentences.zh: 以徐州刺史彭城王爾朱仲遠、雍州刺史隴西王爾朱天光並為大將軍。

translations.literal: Erzhu Zhongyuan, Regional Inspector of Xuzhou and Prince of Pengcheng, and Erzhu Tianguang, Regional Inspector of Yongzhou and Prince of Longxi, were both made Grand Generals.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu Zhongyuan, Regional Inspector of Xuzhou and Prince of Pengcheng, and Erzhu Tianguang, Regional Inspector of Yongzhou and Prince of Longxi, were both made Grand Generals.

sentences.zh: 以柱國大將軍。

translations.literal: Pillar of State Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: Pillar of State Grand General.

sentences.zh: 并州刺史、潁川王爾朱兆為天柱大將軍。

translations.literal: Erzhu Zhao, Regional Inspector of Bing and Prince of Yingchuan, was made Pillar of Heaven Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu Zhao, Regional Inspector of Bing and Prince of Yingchuan, was made Pillar of Heaven Grand General.

sentences.zh: 封晉州刺史、平陽郡公高歡為勃海王。

translations.literal: Gao Huan, Regional Inspector of Jin and Duke of Pingyang, was enfeoffed as Prince of Bohai.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan, Regional Inspector of Jin and Duke of Pingyang, was enfeoffed as Prince of Bohai.

sentences.zh: 以特進、清河王亶為太傅。

translations.literal: Prince of Qinghe Xuan was made Grand Tutor as Special Advance.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Qinghe Xuan was made Grand Tutor as Special Advance.

sentences.zh: 以尚書令、樂平王爾朱世隆為太保。

translations.literal: Erzhu Shilong, Director of the Department of State Affairs and Prince of Leping, was made Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Erzhu Shilong, Director of the Department of State Affairs and Prince of Leping, was made Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 以趙郡王諶為司空。

translations.literal: Prince of Zhao Yuan Chen was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Zhao Yuan Chen was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 丙申，定州刺史侯深破劉靈助於安國城。

translations.literal: On bingshen, Hou Shen, Regional Inspector of Ding, defeated Liu Lingzhu at Anguo City.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Hou Shen, Regional Inspector of Ding, defeated Liu Lingzhu at Anguo City.

sentences.zh: 斬之，傳首京師。

translations.literal: He beheaded him and sent his head to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: He beheaded him and sent his head to the capital.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子，享太廟。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on renzi, the Emperor offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on renzi day the Emperor offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，隴西王爾朱天光破宿勤明達。

translations.literal: On guihai, Prince of Longxi Erzhu Tianguang defeated Su Qinmingda.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day Prince of Longxi Erzhu Tianguang defeated Su Qinmingda.

sentences.zh: 禽送京師，斬之。

translations.literal: He captured him and sent him to the capital, where he was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: He captured him and sent him to the capital, where he was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以侍中爾朱彥伯為司徒。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Erzhu Yanbo, Palace Attendant, was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Erzhu Yanbo, Palace Attendant, was made Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 詔有司不得復稱偽梁。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the authorities not again to call Liang false.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the authorities not again to call Liang false.

sentences.zh: 罷細作之條，無禁鄰國還往。

translations.literal: Regulations on fine craftsmanship were abolished, and neighboring states were not forbidden to come and go.
translations.idiomatic: Regulations on fine craftsmanship were abolished, and neighboring states were not forbidden to come and go.

sentences.zh: 五月丙子，爾朱仲遠使其都督魏僧勖等討崔祖螭於東陽，斬之。

translations.literal: On bingzi in the fifth month, Erzhu Zhongyuan had his Area Commander Wei Sengxu and others campaign against Cui Zuchi at Dongyang and behead him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the fifth month Erzhu Zhongyuan had his Area Commander Wei Sengxu and others campaign against Cui Zuchi at Dongyang and behead him.

sentences.zh: 六月己亥朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, jihai, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the first day of the sixth month, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 庚申，勃海王高歡起兵信都，以誅爾朱氏為名。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Prince of Bohai Gao Huan raised troops at Xindu in the name of executing the Erzhu clan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Prince of Bohai Gao Huan raised troops at Xindu in the name of executing the Erzhu clan.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬申，爾朱世隆等害前太保楊椿、前司空楊津。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on renshen, Erzhu Shilong and others killed former Grand Guardian Yang Chun and former Minister of Works Yang Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renshen day Erzhu Shilong and others killed former Grand Guardian Yang Chun and former Minister of Works Yang Jin.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，司徒爾朱彥伯以旱遜位。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Minister over the Masses Erzhu Yanbo resigned his post because of drought.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Minister over the Masses Erzhu Yanbo resigned his post because of drought.

sentences.zh: 九月，以彭城王爾朱仲遠為太宰。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Prince of Pengcheng Erzhu Zhongyuan was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Prince of Pengcheng Erzhu Zhongyuan was made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以隴西王爾朱天光為大司馬。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Prince of Longxi Erzhu Tianguang was made Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day Prince of Longxi Erzhu Tianguang was made Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，追尊皇考為先帝，皇妣王氏為先太妃。

translations.literal: On guisi, the late Emperor, the Emperor's father, was posthumously honored as Former Emperor, and Lady Wang, the Emperor's mother, as Former Grand Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the late Emperor, the Emperor's father, was posthumously honored as Former Emperor, and Lady Wang, the Emperor's mother, as Former Grand Consort.

sentences.zh: 封皇弟永業為高密王，皇子子恕為勃海王。

translations.literal: The Emperor's younger brother Yongye was enfeoffed as Prince of Gaomi, and the prince's son Zishu as Prince of Bohai.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's younger brother Yongye was enfeoffed as Prince of Gaomi, and the prince's son Zishu as Prince of Bohai.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬寅，高歡推勃海太守元朗即皇帝位於信都。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on renyin, Gao Huan installed Yuan Lang, Regional Administrator of Bohai, as emperor at Xindu.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renyin day Gao Huan installed Yuan Lang, Regional Administrator of Bohai, as emperor at Xindu.

sentences.zh: 二年春閏二月，高歡敗爾朱天光等於韓陵。

translations.literal: In the intercalary second month of spring in the second year, Gao Huan defeated Erzhu Tianguang and others at Hanling.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary second month of spring in the second year Gao Huan defeated Erzhu Tianguang and others at Hanling.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛巳，高歡與廢帝至芒山。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on xinsi, Gao Huan and the Deposed Emperor came to Mount Mang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on xinsi day Gao Huan and the Deposed Emperor came to Mount Mang.

sentences.zh: 使魏蘭根慰喻洛邑，且觀帝之為人。

translations.literal: He sent Wei Langen to comfort and instruct Luoyang and observe the Emperor's character.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Wei Langen to comfort and instruct Luoyang and observe the Emperor's character.

sentences.zh: 蘭根忌帝雅德，還致毀謗，竟從崔陵議，廢帝於崇訓佛寺。

translations.literal: Langen resented the Emperor's refined virtue; on his return he slandered him, and in the end, following Cui Ling's counsel, the Emperor was deposed at Chongxun Buddhist Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: Langen resented the Emperor's refined virtue; on his return he slandered him, and in the end, following Cui Ling's counsel, the Emperor was deposed at Chongxun Buddhist Monastery.

sentences.zh: 而立平陽王修，是為孝武帝。

translations.literal: Prince of Pingyang Xiu was then installed, and he is known as Emperor Xiaowu.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Pingyang Xiu was then installed, and he is known as Emperor Xiaowu.

sentences.zh: 帝既失位，乃賦詩曰：「朱門久可患，紫極非情玩。

translations.literal: Having lost the throne, the Emperor then composed a poem: "The vermilion gate has long been a source of trouble; the purple apex is no object of fond play.
translations.idiomatic: Having lost the throne, the Emperor then composed a poem: "The vermilion gate has long been a source of trouble; the purple apex is no object of fond play.

sentences.zh: 顛覆立可待，一年三易換。

translations.literal: Overthrow and enthronement may be awaited at once; thrice in a year the ruler is changed.
translations.idiomatic: Overthrow and enthronement may be awaited at once; thrice in a year the ruler is changed.

sentences.zh: 時運正如此，唯有修真觀。

translations.literal: When the times run thus, there is only cultivating the true and contemplating."
translations.idiomatic: When the times run thus, there is only cultivating the true and contemplating."

sentences.zh: 」五月丙申，帝遇弒，殂於門下外省，時年三十五。

translations.literal: On bingshen in the fifth month, the Emperor was assassinated; he died in the outer quarters of the Gate Department, aged thirty-five.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the fifth month the Emperor was assassinated; he died in the outer quarters of the Gate Department, aged thirty-five.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝詔百司赴會，葬用王禮。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowu ordered all offices to attend the funeral and buried him with princely rites.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowu ordered all offices to attend the funeral and buried him with princely rites.

sentences.zh: 加九旒、鑾輅、黃屋、左纛，班劍百二十人。

translations.literal: Nine tassels, imperial carriage, yellow canopy, left great banner, and a guard of one hundred twenty swordbearers were added.
translations.idiomatic: Nine tassels, imperial carriage, yellow canopy, left great banner, and a guard of one hundred twenty swordbearers were added.

sentences.zh: 後西魏追謚節閔皇帝。

translations.literal: Later Western Wei posthumously honored him as Emperor Jiemin.
translations.idiomatic: Later Western Wei posthumously honored him as Emperor Jiemin.

sentences.zh: 廢帝朗

translations.literal: The Deposed Emperor Lang.
translations.idiomatic: The Deposed Emperor Lang.

sentences.zh: 廢帝諱朗字仲哲，章武王融第三子也。

translations.literal: The Deposed Emperor, taboo name Lang, style name Zhongzhe, was the third son of Prince of Zhangwu Rong.
translations.idiomatic: The Deposed Emperor, taboo name Lang, style name Zhongzhe, was the third son of Prince of Zhangwu Rong.

sentences.zh: 母曰程氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Lady Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Lady Cheng.

sentences.zh: 帝少稱明悟。

translations.literal: In youth the Emperor was said to be bright and perceptive.
translations.idiomatic: In youth the Emperor was said to be bright and perceptive.

sentences.zh: 元曄建明二年正月戊子，為勃海太守。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year of Jianming, on wuzi, he was made Regional Administrator of Bohai.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year of Jianming, on wuzi day he was made Regional Administrator of Bohai.

sentences.zh: 普泰元年十月，勃海王高歡奉帝以主號令。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the first year of Putai, Prince of Bohai Gao Huan received the Emperor to hold the imperial title and issue orders.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the first year of Putai Prince of Bohai Gao Huan received the Emperor to hold the imperial title and issue orders.

sentences.zh: 中興元年冬十月壬寅，皇帝即位於信都西。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter of the first year of Zhongxing, on renyin, the Emperor took the throne west of Xindu.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter of the first year of Zhongxing, on renyin day the Emperor took the throne west of Xindu.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改普泰元年為中興。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and the first year of Putai was changed to Zhongxing.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and the first year of Putai was changed to Zhongxing.

sentences.zh: 以勃海王高歡為丞相，都督中外諸軍事。

translations.literal: Prince of Bohai Gao Huan was made Chancellor and Area Commander of all military affairs within and without.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Bohai Gao Huan was made Chancellor and Area Commander of all military affairs within and without.

sentences.zh: 以河北大使高幹為司空。

translations.literal: Gao Gan, Grand Ambassador of Hebei, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Gan, Grand Ambassador of Hebei, was appointed Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，高歡大破爾朱兆於廣阿。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Gao Huan inflicted a great defeat on Erzhu Zhao at Guang'a.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Gao Huan inflicted a great defeat on Erzhu Zhao at Guang'a.

sentences.zh: 十一月，梁將元樹入據譙城。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Liang General Yuan Shu entered and seized Qiao City.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Liang General Yuan Shu entered and seized Qiao City.

sentences.zh: 二年春二月甲子，以勃海王高歡為大丞相、柱國大將軍、太師。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring in the second year, on jiazi, Prince of Bohai Gao Huan was made Grand Chancellor, Pillar of State Grand General, and Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring in the second year, on jiazi day Prince of Bohai Gao Huan was made Grand Chancellor, Pillar of State Grand General, and Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 及歡敗爾朱氏於韓陵，四月辛巳，帝於河陽遜位於別邸。

translations.literal: When Huan defeated the Erzhu clan at Hanling, on xinsi in the fourth month the Emperor yielded the throne at a separate residence in Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: When Huan defeated the Erzhu clan at Hanling, on xinsi in the fourth month the Emperor yielded the throne at a separate residence in Heyang.

sentences.zh: 五月，孝武封帝為安定郡王。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Emperor Xiaowu enfeoffed the Emperor as Prince of Anding.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Emperor Xiaowu enfeoffed him as Prince of Anding.

sentences.zh: 十一月，殂於門下外省。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, he died in the outer quarters of the Gate Department.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month he died in the outer quarters of the Gate Department.

sentences.zh: 時年二十。

translations.literal: He was aged twenty.
translations.idiomatic: He was aged twenty.

sentences.zh: 永熙二年，葬於鄴西南野馬崗。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongxi, he was buried at Yema Hill southwest of Ye.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongxi he was buried at Yema Hill southwest of Ye.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowu.

sentences.zh: 孝武皇帝諱修，字孝則，廣平武穆王懷之第三子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowu, taboo name Xiu, style name Xiaozi, was the third son of Prince of Guangping Wumu Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowu, taboo name Xiu, style name Xiaozi, was the third son of Prince of Guangping Wumu Huai.

sentences.zh: 母曰李氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Lady Li.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Lady Li.

sentences.zh: 帝性沈厚，學涉，好武事，遍體有鱗文。

translations.literal: The Emperor was deep and steady in nature, learned and widely read, fond of martial affairs, and had scale patterns over his entire body.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was deep and steady in nature, learned and widely read, fond of martial affairs, and had scale patterns over his entire body.

sentences.zh: 年十八，封汝陽縣公。

translations.literal: At eighteen he was enfeoffed as Duke of Ruyang.
translations.idiomatic: At eighteen he was enfeoffed as Duke of Ruyang.

sentences.zh: 夢人有從諱謂己曰：「汝當大貴，得二十五年。

translations.literal: In a dream someone addressed him by taboo and said: "You will attain great honor and receive twenty-five years."
translations.idiomatic: In a dream someone addressed him by taboo and said: "You will attain great honor and receive twenty-five years."

sentences.zh: 」永安三年，封平陽王。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongan he was enfeoffed as Prince of Pingyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongan he was enfeoffed as Prince of Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 普泰中，為侍中、尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: In the Putai era he was Palace Attendant and Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the Putai era he was Palace Attendant and Left Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 中興二年，高歡既敗爾朱氏，廢帝自以疏遠，請遜大位。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhongxing, after Gao Huan had defeated the Erzhu clan, the Deposed Emperor, considering himself remote in kinship, requested to yield the great throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Zhongxing, after Gao Huan had defeated the Erzhu clan, the Deposed Emperor, considering himself remote in kinship, requested to yield the great throne.

sentences.zh: 歡乃與百寮議。

translations.literal: Huan then deliberated with the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: Huan then deliberated with the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 以孝文不可無後，時召汝南王悅於梁。

translations.literal: Because Emperor Xiaowen could not be without posterity, at the time Prince of Runan Yue was summoned from Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Because Emperor Xiaowen could not be without posterity, at the time Prince of Runan Yue was summoned from Liang.

sentences.zh: 至，將立之，宿昔而止。

translations.literal: When he arrived, they were about to install him, but stopped after a night's consideration.
translations.idiomatic: When he arrived, they were about to install him, but stopped after a night's consideration.

sentences.zh: 又諸王皆逃匿，帝在田舍。

translations.literal: The other princes had all fled and hidden; the Emperor was in a farmstead.
translations.idiomatic: The other princes had all fled and hidden; the Emperor was in a farmstead.

sentences.zh: 先是，嵩山道士潘彌望見洛陽城西有天子氣，候之乃帝也。

translations.literal: Earlier, the Mount Song Daoist Pan Miwang had seen imperial aura west of Luoyang city; on watching, it proved to be the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Mount Song Daoist Pan Miwang had seen imperial aura west of Luoyang city; on watching, it proved to be the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 於是造第密言之。

translations.literal: Thereupon he built a residence and spoke of it in secret.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he built a residence and spoke of it in secret.

sentences.zh: 居五旬而高歡使斛斯椿求帝。

translations.literal: After fifty days Gao Huan sent Husu Chun to seek the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: After fifty days Gao Huan sent Husu Chun to seek the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 椿從帝所親王思政見帝。

translations.literal: Chun met the Emperor through his intimate Wang Sizheng.
translations.idiomatic: Chun met the Emperor through his intimate Wang Sizheng.

sentences.zh: 帝變色曰：「非賣我耶？」

translations.literal: The Emperor changed color and said: "Are you not selling me?"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor changed color and said: "Are you not selling me?"

sentences.zh: 椿遂以白歡。

translations.literal: Chun reported this to Huan.
translations.idiomatic: Chun reported this to Huan.

sentences.zh: 歡遣四百騎奉迎帝入氈帳，陳誠，泣下沾襟。

translations.literal: Huan sent four hundred horsemen to receive the Emperor into a felt tent, expressed sincerity, and wept until his lapels were wet.
translations.idiomatic: Huan sent four hundred horsemen to receive the Emperor into a felt tent, expressed sincerity, and wept until his lapels were wet.

sentences.zh: 讓以寡德。

translations.literal: He yielded because of meager virtue.
translations.idiomatic: He yielded because of meager virtue.

sentences.zh: 歡再拜，帝亦拜。

translations.literal: Huan bowed twice; the Emperor also bowed.
translations.idiomatic: Huan bowed twice; the Emperor also bowed.

sentences.zh: 歡出，備服御，進湯沐。

translations.literal: Huan went out, prepared robes and regalia, and presented bath and toilet.
translations.idiomatic: Huan went out, prepared robes and regalia, and presented bath and toilet.

sentences.zh: 達夜嚴警。

translations.literal: Through the night strict guard was kept.
translations.idiomatic: Through the night strict guard was kept.

sentences.zh: 昧爽，文武執鞭以朝。

translations.literal: At dawn civil and military officials held whips to attend court.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn civil and military officials held whips to attend court.

sentences.zh: 使斛斯椿奉勸進表。

translations.literal: Husu Chun was sent to present the memorial urging accession.
translations.idiomatic: Husu Chun was sent to present the memorial urging accession.

sentences.zh: 椿入帷門，罄折延首而不敢前。

translations.literal: Chun entered the tent door, bowed with full bend and extended neck, yet did not dare advance.
translations.idiomatic: Chun entered the tent door, bowed with full bend and extended neck, yet did not dare advance.

sentences.zh: 帝令思政取表，曰：「視，便不得不稱朕矣。」

translations.literal: The Emperor ordered Sizheng to take the memorial and said: "Look—it cannot but call me Emperor now."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor ordered Sizheng to take the memorial and said: "Look—it cannot but call me Emperor now."

sentences.zh: 於是假廢帝安定王詔策而禪位焉。

translations.literal: Thereupon, using the Deposed Emperor's edict and investiture document as Prince of Anding, he received the yielded throne.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon, using the Deposed Emperor's edict and investiture document as Prince of Anding, he received the yielded throne.

sentences.zh: 即位於東郭之外。

translations.literal: He took the throne outside the eastern gate.
translations.idiomatic: He took the throne outside the eastern gate.

sentences.zh: 用代都舊制，以黑氈蒙七人，歡居其一。

translations.literal: Following the old regulations of the capital in Dai, seven men were covered with black felt, Huan occupying one place.
translations.idiomatic: Following the old regulations of the capital in Dai, seven men were covered with black felt, Huan occupying one place.

sentences.zh: 帝於氈上西向拜天訖，自東陽、雲龍門入。

translations.literal: When the Emperor on the felt had finished bowing west to Heaven, he entered through the Dongyang and Cloud Dragon gates.
translations.idiomatic: When the Emperor on the felt had finished bowing west to Heaven, he entered through the Dongyang and Cloud Dragon gates.

sentences.zh: 永熙元年夏四月戊子，皇帝御太極前殿，群臣朝賀。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the first year of Yongxi, on wuzi, the Emperor took seat in the Hall before the Supreme Ultimate; officials paid homage in congratulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer of the first year of Yongxi, on wuzi day the Emperor took seat in the Hall before the Supreme Ultimate; officials paid homage in congratulation.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，升閶闔門大赦。

translations.literal: When the rites were complete, he ascended the Gate of Opening the Gate to All Directions and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: When the rites were complete, he ascended the Gate of Opening the Gate to All Directions and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 改中興二年為太昌元年。

translations.literal: The second year of Zhongxing was changed to the first year of Taichang.
translations.idiomatic: The second year of Zhongxing was changed to the first year of Taichang.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，高歡還鄴。

translations.literal: On renchen, Gao Huan returned to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Gao Huan returned to Ye.

sentences.zh: 五月丙申，節閔帝殂。

translations.literal: On bingshen in the fifth month, Emperor Jiemin died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the fifth month Emperor Jiemin died.

sentences.zh: 以太傅、淮陽王欣為太師，改封沛郡王。

translations.literal: Grand Tutor and Prince of Huaiyang Xin was made Grand Preceptor, and his title was changed to Prince of Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Tutor and Prince of Huaiyang Xin was made Grand Preceptor, and his title was changed to Prince of Guangling.

sentences.zh: 以司徒、趙郡王諶為太保。

translations.literal: Minister over the Masses and Prince of Zhao Yuan Chen was made Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Minister over the Masses and Prince of Zhao Yuan Chen was made Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 以司空、南陽王寶炬為太尉。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant and Prince of Nanyang Bao Ju was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant and Prince of Nanyang Bao Ju was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 以太保長孫承業為太傅。

translations.literal: Grand Guardian Changsun Chengye was made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Guardian Changsun Chengye was made Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，復前司空高乾位。

translations.literal: On xinchou, former Minister of Works Gao Gan was restored to his post.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day former Minister of Works Gao Gan was restored to his post.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以儀同三司、清河王亶為司徒。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Prince of Qinghe Xuan, Commissioner Equal to the Third Rank, was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Prince of Qinghe Xuan, Commissioner Equal to the Third Rank, was made Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，內外解嚴。

translations.literal: On yimao, martial law was lifted within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day martial law was lifted within and without.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥朔，帝於華林園納訟。

translations.literal: On the first day of the sixth month, guihai, the Emperor heard lawsuits in the Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the first day of the sixth month, the Emperor heard lawsuits in the Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，南陽王寶炬坐事，降為驃騎大將軍，開府，以王歸第。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Prince of Nanyang Bao Ju, because of an offense, was reduced to General of Agile Cavalry with an opening office and returned to his residence as prince.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Prince of Nanyang Bao Ju, because of an offense, was reduced to General of Agile Cavalry with an opening office and returned to his residence as prince.

sentences.zh: 己卯，臨顯陽殿納訟。

translations.literal: On jimao, he came to the Hall of Illuminated Yang to hear lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day he came to the Hall of Illuminated Yang to hear lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，詔曰：「間者，凶權誕恣，法令變常，遂立夷貊輕賦，冀收天下之意。

translations.literal: On bingxu, an edict said: "Recently vicious power was born and ran wild; laws and regulations were changed from the norm; then light levies on barbarian peoples were set up, hoping to win the hearts of all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day an edict said: "Recently vicious power was born and ran wild; laws and regulations were changed from the norm; then light levies on barbarian peoples were set up, hoping to win the hearts of all under Heaven.

sentences.zh: 隨以箕斂之重，終納十倍之征，掩目捕雀，何能過此！

translations.literal: This was followed by heavy exactions, and in the end a tenfold levy was collected—covering the eyes to catch sparrows: what could surpass this!
translations.idiomatic: This was followed by heavy exactions, and in the end a tenfold levy was collected—covering the eyes to catch sparrows: what could surpass this!

sentences.zh: 今歲租調，且兩收一丐，明年復舊。

translations.literal: This year's land tax and corvée shall for now be collected at half rate once; next year the old rate shall be restored."
translations.idiomatic: This year's land tax and corvée shall for now be collected at half rate once; next year the old rate shall be restored."

sentences.zh: 」秋七月庚子，以南陽王寶炬為太尉。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengzi, Prince of Nanyang Bao Ju was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengzi day Prince of Nanyang Bao Ju was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，帝臨顯陽殿，親理冤獄。

translations.literal: On yimao, the Emperor came to the Hall of Illuminated Yang and personally judged wrongful imprisonments.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the Emperor came to the Hall of Illuminated Yang and personally judged wrongful imprisonments.

sentences.zh: 是月，東南道大行臺樊子鵠大破梁軍於譙城，禽其將元樹。

translations.literal: That month, Fan Zihong, Grand Ambassador of the Southeastern Circuit, inflicted a great defeat on the Liang army at Qiao City and captured their general Yuan Shu.
translations.idiomatic: That month Fan Zihong, Grand Ambassador of the Southeastern Circuit, inflicted a great defeat on the Liang army at Qiao City and captured their general Yuan Shu.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，封西中郎將元寧為高平王。

translations.literal: On dingmao in the eighth month, Western Gentlemen-General Yuan Ning was enfeoffed as Prince of Gaoping.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the eighth month Western Gentlemen-General Yuan Ning was enfeoffed as Prince of Gaoping.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，進燕郡公賀拔允爵為王。

translations.literal: On guimao, Duke of Yancheng Heba Yun was advanced in noble rank to prince.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day Duke of Yancheng Heba Yun was advanced to princely rank.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，改封沛郡王欣為廣陵王；

translations.literal: On guichou, Prince of Pei Xin was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Guangling;
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Prince of Pei Xin was transferred and enfeoffed as Prince of Guangling;

sentences.zh: 節閔子勃海王子恕為沛郡王。

translations.literal: Zishu, son of Jiemin and Prince of Bohai, was made Prince of Pei.
translations.idiomatic: Zishu, son of Jiemin and Prince of Bohai, was made Prince of Pei.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the tenth month of winter, xinyou, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the first day of the tenth month of winter, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁酉，祀圓丘。

translations.literal: On dingyou in the eleventh month, sacrifice was offered at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the eleventh month sacrifice was offered at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，殺安定王朗及東海王曄。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Prince of Anding Lang and Prince of Donghai Ye were killed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Prince of Anding Lang and Prince of Donghai Ye were killed.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以汝南王悅為侍中、大司馬，開府。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Prince of Runan Yue was made Palace Attendant and Grand Marshal with an opening office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Prince of Runan Yue was made Palace Attendant and Grand Marshal with an opening office.

sentences.zh: 葬太后胡氏。

translations.literal: Empress Dowager Hu was buried.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Dowager Hu was buried.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，殺大司馬、汝南王悅。

translations.literal: On dinghai in the twelfth month, Grand Marshal and Prince of Runan Yue was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the twelfth month Grand Marshal and Prince of Runan Yue was killed.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元為永興。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and the era name was changed to Yongxing.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed, and the era name was changed to Yongxing.

sentences.zh: 以同明元時年號，尋改為永熙。

translations.literal: Because it was the same as an era name of Emperor Mingyuan, it was soon changed to Yongxi.
translations.idiomatic: Because it was the same as an era name of Emperor Mingyuan, it was soon changed to Yongxi.

sentences.zh: 是歲，蠕蠕、嚈噠、高麗、契丹、庫莫奚、高昌等國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Rouran, Yanda, Goguryeo, Khitan, Kumo Xi, Gaochang, and other states all sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Rouran, Yanda, Goguryeo, Khitan, Kumo Xi, Gaochang, and other states all sent envoys to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春二月壬戌，大赦。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring in the third year, on renxu, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring in the third year, on renxu day a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 壬午，封左衛將軍元斌之為潁川王。

translations.literal: On renwu, Left Guard General Yuan Binzhi was enfeoffed as Prince of Yingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu day Left Guard General Yuan Binzhi was enfeoffed as Prince of Yingchuan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸丑朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fourth month of summer, guichou, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the first day of the fourth month of summer, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 辛未，高平王寧坐事降爵為公。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Prince of Gaoping Ning, because of an offense, was reduced in noble rank to duke.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day Prince of Gaoping Ning, because of an offense, was reduced in noble rank to duke.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，置勛府庶子，箱別六百人；

translations.literal: On bingxu in the fifth month, merit-office subordinates were established, six hundred men per squad;
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the fifth month merit-office subordinates were established, six hundred men per squad;

sentences.zh: 騎官，箱別二百人；

translations.literal: cavalry officers, two hundred men per squad;
translations.idiomatic: cavalry officers, two hundred men per squad;

sentences.zh: 閣內部曲，數千人。

translations.literal: and inner-palace troops, several thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: and inner-palace troops, several thousand men.

sentences.zh: 帝內圖高歡，乃以斛斯椿為領軍，使與王思政等統之，以為心膂。

translations.literal: The Emperor inwardly plotted against Gao Huan; he therefore made Husu Chun Commandant of the Guard and had him together with Wang Sizheng and others command them as his inner strength.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor inwardly plotted against Gao Huan; he therefore made Husu Chun Commandant of the Guard and had him together with Wang Sizheng and others command them as his inner strength.

sentences.zh: 軍謀朝政，咸決於椿。

translations.literal: Military plans and court government were all decided by Chun.
translations.idiomatic: Military plans and court government were all decided by Chun.

sentences.zh: 分置督將及河南、關西諸刺史。

translations.literal: Area commanders and regional inspectors of Henan, Guanxi, and other circuits were separately appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Area commanders and regional inspectors of Henan, Guanxi, and other circuits were separately appointed.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，下詔戒嚴，楊聲伐梁，實謀北討。

translations.literal: On xinmao, an edict proclaimed martial alert, publicly announcing a campaign against Liang while actually plotting a northern expedition.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day an edict proclaimed martial alert, publicly announcing a campaign against Liang while actually plotting a northern expedition.

sentences.zh: 是夏，契丹、高麗、吐谷渾並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That summer Khitan, Goguryeo, and Tuyuhun all sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That summer Khitan, Goguryeo, and Tuyuhun all sent envoys to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己丑，帝親總六軍十餘萬，次河橋。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on jichou, the Emperor personally commanded more than one hundred thousand of the Six Armies and halted at Heqiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jichou day the Emperor personally commanded more than one hundred thousand of the Six Armies and halted at Heqiao.

sentences.zh: 高歡引軍東渡。

translations.literal: Gao Huan led his army east across the river.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Huan led his army east across the river.

sentences.zh: 丙午，帝率南陽王寶炬、清河王亶、廣陽王湛、斛斯椿以五千騎宿於瀍西楊王別舍。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the Emperor led Prince of Nanyang Bao Ju, Prince of Qinghe Xuan, Prince of Guangyang Zhan, and Husu Chun with five thousand horsemen to lodge at the Yang Prince's separate residence west of the Chan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Emperor led Prince of Nanyang Bao Ju, Prince of Qinghe Xuan, Prince of Guangyang Zhan, and Husu Chun with five thousand horsemen to lodge at the Yang Prince's separate residence west of the Chan.

sentences.zh: 沙門都維那惠臻負璽持千牛刀以從。

translations.literal: The chief monk Huizhen of the Buddhist order carried the seal and held the thousand-ox knife in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: The chief monk Huizhen of the Buddhist order carried the seal and held the thousand-ox knife in attendance.

sentences.zh: 有牛百頭，盡殺以食軍士。
