translations.literal: There were one hundred oxen; all were killed to feed the troops.
translations.idiomatic: There were one hundred oxen; all were killed to feed the troops.

sentences.zh: 眾知帝將出，其夜亡者過半。

translations.literal: The masses knew the Emperor was about to depart; that night more than half fled.
translations.idiomatic: The masses knew the Emperor was about to depart; that night more than half fled.

sentences.zh: 清河、廣陽二王亦逃歸。

translations.literal: The Princes of Qinghe and Guangyang also fled back.
translations.idiomatic: The Princes of Qinghe and Guangyang also fled back.

sentences.zh: 略陽公宇文泰遣都督駱超、李賢和各領數百騎赴。

translations.literal: Duke of Lueyang Yuwen Tai sent Area Commanders Luo Chao and Li Xianhe, each leading several hundred horsemen, to come to his aid.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Lueyang Yuwen Tai sent Area Commanders Luo Chao and Li Xianhe, each leading several hundred horsemen, to come to his aid.

sentences.zh: 駱超先至。

translations.literal: Luo Chao arrived first.
translations.idiomatic: Luo Chao arrived first.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，賢和會帝於崤中。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Xianhe joined the Emperor in the center of the passes.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Xianhe joined the Emperor in the center of the passes.

sentences.zh: 己酉，高歡入洛，遣婁昭及河南尹元子思領左右侍官追帝，請回駕。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Gao Huan entered Luoyang and sent Lou Zhao and Regional Administrator of Henan Yuan Zisi to lead the attendants in pursuit of the Emperor and request his return.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Gao Huan entered Luoyang and sent Lou Zhao and Regional Administrator of Henan Yuan Zisi to lead the attendants in pursuit of the Emperor and request his return.

sentences.zh: 高昂率勁騎及帝於陜西。

translations.literal: Gao Ang led crack horsemen and caught up with the Emperor west of Shan.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Ang led crack horsemen and caught up with the Emperor west of Shan.

sentences.zh: 帝鞭馬長騖至湖城，饑渴甚，有王思村人以麥飯壺漿獻帝。

translations.literal: The Emperor whipped his horse in a long gallop to Hucheng; he was very hungry and thirsty, and a man of Wangsi village presented the Emperor with wheat meal and pot liquor.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor whipped his horse in a long gallop to Hucheng; he was very hungry and thirsty, and a man of Wangsi village presented the Emperor with wheat meal and pot liquor.

sentences.zh: 帝甘之，復一村十年。

translations.literal: The Emperor found it sweet and remitted one village's taxes for ten years.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor found it sweet and remitted one village's taxes for ten years.

sentences.zh: 是歲二月，熒惑入南斗，眾星北流，群鼠浮河向鄴。

translations.literal: That year in the second month Mars entered the Southern Dipper, the host of stars flowed north, and rats in droves floated on the river toward Ye.
translations.idiomatic: That year in the second month Mars entered the Southern Dipper, the host of stars flowed north, and rats in droves floated on the river toward Ye.

sentences.zh: 梁武跣而下殿，以禳星變。

translations.literal: Emperor Wu of Liang went barefoot down from the hall to perform rites against the stellar omen.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Liang went barefoot down from the hall to perform rites against the stellar omen.

sentences.zh: 及聞帝之西，慚曰：「虜亦應天乎？

translations.literal: When he heard the Emperor had gone west, he said in shame: "Do the barbarians also respond to Heaven?"
translations.idiomatic: When he heard the Emperor had gone west, he said in shame: "Do the barbarians also respond to Heaven?"

sentences.zh: 」帝至稠桑，潼關大都督毛洪賓迎獻食。

translations.literal: The Emperor reached Chousang; Mao Hongbin, Area Commander of Tong Pass, came to welcome him and presented food.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor reached Chousang; Mao Hongbin, Area Commander of Tong Pass, came to welcome him and presented food.

sentences.zh: 八月，宇文泰遣大都督趙貴、梁禦甲騎二千來赴，乃奉迎。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Yuwen Tai sent Area Commanders Zhao Gui and Liang Yu with two thousand armored horsemen to come to his aid, and they received the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Yuwen Tai sent Area Commanders Zhao Gui and Liang Yu with two thousand armored horsemen to come to his aid, and they received the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 帝過河謂禦曰：「此水東流而朕西上，若得重謁洛陽廟，是卿等功也。

translations.literal: Crossing the river the Emperor said to Yu: "This water flows east while I go west; if I can again worship at the Luoyang temples, it will be your achievement."
translations.idiomatic: Crossing the river the Emperor said to Yu: "This water flows east while I go west; if I can again worship at the Luoyang temples, it will be your achievement."

sentences.zh: 」帝及左右皆流涕。

translations.literal: The Emperor and those about him all wept.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor and those about him all wept.

sentences.zh: 宇文泰迎帝於東陽，帝勞之，將士皆呼萬歲。

translations.literal: Yuwen Tai received the Emperor at Dongyang; the Emperor comforted him, and officers and soldiers all shouted ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai received the Emperor at Dongyang; the Emperor comforted him, and officers and soldiers all shouted ten thousand years.

sentences.zh: 遂入長安。

translations.literal: He then entered Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: He then entered Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 以雍州公廨為宮，大赦。

translations.literal: The Yongzhou public offices were made the palace, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongzhou public offices were made the palace, and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，高歡推司徒、清河王亶為大司馬，承制總萬機，居尚書省。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Gao Huan installed Minister over the Masses and Prince of Qinghe Xuan as Grand Marshal, holding the imperial seal and directing all affairs, residing in the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Gao Huan installed Minister over the Masses and Prince of Qinghe Xuan as Grand Marshal, holding the imperial seal and directing all affairs, residing in the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 歡追車駕至潼關。

translations.literal: Huan pursued the imperial carriage to Tong Pass.
translations.idiomatic: Huan pursued the imperial carriage to Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 九月己酉，歡東還洛陽。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on jiyou, Huan returned east to Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiyou day Huan returned east to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 帝親督眾攻潼關，斬其行臺華長瑜，又克華州。

translations.literal: The Emperor personally directed the masses in attacking Tong Pass, beheaded Mobile Secretariat Commander Hua Changyu, and also took Hua Province.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor personally directed the masses in attacking Tong Pass, beheaded Mobile Secretariat Commander Hua Changyu, and also took Hua Province.

sentences.zh: 其冬十月，高歡推清河王亶子善見為主，徙都鄴，是為東魏。

translations.literal: That winter in the tenth month, Gao Huan installed Shan Jian, son of Prince of Qinghe Xuan, as ruler, moved the capital to Ye, and this is known as Eastern Wei.
translations.idiomatic: That winter in the tenth month Gao Huan installed Shan Jian, son of Prince of Qinghe Xuan, as ruler, moved the capital to Ye, and this is known as Eastern Wei.

sentences.zh: 魏於此始分為二。

translations.literal: From this Wei began to be divided in two.
translations.idiomatic: From this Wei began to be divided in two.

sentences.zh: 帝之在洛也，從妹不嫁者三：一曰平原公主明月，南陽王同產也；

translations.literal: While the Emperor was at Luoyang, three younger cousins by the female line remained unmarried: first, Princess of Pingyuan Mingyue, born of the same mother as Prince of Nanyang;
translations.idiomatic: While the Emperor was at Luoyang, three younger cousins by the female line remained unmarried: first, Princess of Pingyuan Mingyue, born of the same mother as Prince of Nanyang;

sentences.zh: 二曰安德公主，清河王懌女也；

translations.literal: second, Princess of Ande, daughter of Prince of Qinghe Yi;
translations.idiomatic: second, Princess of Ande, daughter of Prince of Qinghe Yi;

sentences.zh: 三曰蒺藜，亦封公主。

translations.literal: third, Jili, who was also enfeoffed as princess.
translations.idiomatic: third, Jili, who was also enfeoffed as princess.

sentences.zh: 帝內宴，命諸婦人詠詩。

translations.literal: At an inner banquet the Emperor ordered the women to compose poems.
translations.idiomatic: At an inner banquet the Emperor ordered the women to compose poems.

sentences.zh: 或詠鮑照樂府曰：「朱門九重門九閨，願逐明月入君懷。

translations.literal: Some quoted Bao Zhao's yuefu: "Vermilion gates, ninefold gates and ninefold inner quarters—I wish to follow the bright moon into my lord's bosom."
translations.idiomatic: Some quoted Bao Zhao's yuefu: "Vermilion gates, ninefold gates and ninefold inner quarters—I wish to follow the bright moon into my lord's bosom."

sentences.zh: 」帝既以明月入關。

translations.literal: The Emperor had already taken Mingyue west through the passes.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor had already taken Mingyue west through the passes.

sentences.zh: 蒺藜自縊。

translations.literal: Jili hanged herself.
translations.idiomatic: Jili hanged herself.

sentences.zh: 宇文泰使元氏諸王取明月殺之。

translations.literal: Yuwen Tai had princes of the Yuan clan take Mingyue and kill her.
translations.idiomatic: Yuwen Tai had princes of the Yuan clan take Mingyue and kill her.

sentences.zh: 帝不悅，或時彎弓，或時推案，君臣由此不安平。

translations.literal: The Emperor was displeased; at times he would bend his bow, at times push aside his desk; from this lord and ministers were no longer at ease.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was displeased; at times he would bend his bow, at times push aside his desk; from this lord and ministers were no longer at ease.

sentences.zh: 閏十二月癸巳，潘彌奏言：「今日當慎有急兵。

translations.literal: In the intercalary twelfth month, on guisi, Pan Mi memorialized: "Today one must beware of sudden troops."
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary twelfth month, on guisi day Pan Mi memorialized: "Today one must beware of sudden troops."

sentences.zh: 」其夜，帝在逍遙園宴阿至羅，顧侍臣曰：「此處仿佛華林園，使人聊增淒怨。

translations.literal: That night the Emperor feasted with the Azhiluo at the Leisure Garden; he turned to his attendants and said: "This place resembles the Hualin Garden and briefly adds to one's grief."
translations.idiomatic: That night the Emperor feasted with the Azhiluo at the Leisure Garden; he turned to his attendants and said: "This place resembles the Hualin Garden and briefly adds to one's grief."

sentences.zh: 」命取所乘波斯騮馬，使南陽王躍之。

translations.literal: He ordered his Persian bay horse brought and had Prince of Nanyang leap it.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered his Persian bay horse brought and had Prince of Nanyang leap it.

sentences.zh: 將攀鞍，蹶而死，帝惡之。

translations.literal: About to mount, it stumbled and died; the Emperor took this as ill omen.
translations.idiomatic: About to mount, it stumbled and died; the Emperor took this as ill omen.

sentences.zh: 日晏還宮，至後門，馬驚不前，鞭打入。

translations.literal: At dusk he returned to the palace; at the rear gate the horse started and would not advance; he whipped it in.
translations.idiomatic: At dusk he returned to the palace; at the rear gate the horse started and would not advance; he whipped it in.

sentences.zh: 謂潘彌曰：「今日幸無他不？

translations.literal: He said to Pan Mi: "Today fortunately nothing else happened?"
translations.idiomatic: He said to Pan Mi: "Today fortunately nothing else happened?"

sentences.zh: 」彌曰：「過夜半則大吉。

translations.literal: Mi said: "Past midnight will be greatly auspicious."
translations.idiomatic: Mi said: "Past midnight will be greatly auspicious."

sentences.zh: 」須臾，帝飲酒，遇鴆而崩，時年二十五。

translations.literal: Shortly after, the Emperor drank wine and met poison and died, aged twenty-five.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly after, the Emperor drank wine and met poison and died, aged twenty-five.

sentences.zh: 謚曰孝武。

translations.literal: His posthumous title is Xiaowu.
translations.idiomatic: His posthumous title is Xiaowu.

sentences.zh: 殯於草堂佛寺。

translations.literal: He was laid in state at Caotang Buddhist Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: He was laid in state at Caotang Buddhist Monastery.

sentences.zh: 十餘年乃葬雲陵。

translations.literal: Only after more than ten years was he buried at Yunling.
translations.idiomatic: Only after more than ten years was he buried at Yunling.

sentences.zh: 始宣武、孝明間謠曰：「狐非狐，貉非貉，焦梨狗子嚙斷索。

translations.literal: In the time of Emperor Xuanwu and Emperor Xiaoming there was a rhyme: "Fox yet not fox, badger yet not badger—the scorched-pear dog gnaws through the cord."
translations.idiomatic: In the time of Emperor Xuanwu and Emperor Xiaoming there was a rhyme: "Fox yet not fox, badger yet not badger—the scorched-pear dog gnaws through the cord."

sentences.zh: 」識者以為索謂本索髮，焦梨狗子指宇文泰，俗謂之黑獺也。

translations.literal: Those who understood said the cord meant the original cord of hair, and the scorched-pear dog pointed to Yuwen Tai, commonly called the black otter.
translations.idiomatic: Those who understood said the cord meant the original cord of hair, and the scorched-pear dog pointed to Yuwen Tai, commonly called the black otter.

sentences.zh: 文皇帝諱寶炬，孝文皇帝之孫，京兆王愉之子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen, taboo name Bao Ju, was a grandson of Emperor Xiaowen and son of Prince of Jingzhao Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen, taboo name Bao Ju, was a grandson of Emperor Xiaowen and son of Prince of Jingzhao Yu.

sentences.zh: 母曰楊氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Lady Yang.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Lady Yang.

sentences.zh: 帝正始初坐父愉罪，兄弟皆幽宗正寺。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhengshi the Emperor sat under his father Yu's crime; he and his brothers were all confined in the Temple of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Zhengshi the Emperor sat under his father Yu's crime; he and his brothers were all confined in the Temple of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 及宣武崩，乃得雪。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xuanwu died, they were cleared.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuanwu died, they were cleared.

sentences.zh: 正光中，拜直閣將軍。

translations.literal: In the Zhengguang era he was appointed Direct Attendant General.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhengguang era he was appointed Direct Attendant General.

sentences.zh: 時胡太后多嬖寵，帝與明帝謀誅之。

translations.literal: At the time Empress Dowager Hu had many favorites; the Emperor with Emperor Ming plotted to execute her.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Empress Dowager Hu had many favorites; the Emperor with Emperor Ming plotted to execute her.

sentences.zh: 事泄，免官。

translations.literal: The affair leaked and he was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: The affair leaked and he was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 武泰中，封邵縣侯。

translations.literal: In Wutai he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Shao.
translations.idiomatic: In Wutai he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Shao.

sentences.zh: 永安三年，進封南陽王。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongan he was advanced to Prince of Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Yongan he was advanced to Prince of Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 孝武即位，拜太尉，加侍中。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu acceded he was appointed Grand Commandant and added as Palace Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu acceded he was appointed Grand Commandant and added as Palace Attendant.

sentences.zh: 永熙二年，進位太保、開府、尚書令。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongxi he was advanced to Grand Guardian, opening office, and Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Yongxi he was advanced to Grand Guardian, opening office, and Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 三年，孝武與高歡構難，以帝為中軍四面大都督。

translations.literal: In the third year, when Emperor Xiaowu and Gao Huan came into conflict, the Emperor was made Area Commander of the Center Army on all four sides.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, when Emperor Xiaowu and Gao Huan came into conflict, the Emperor was made Area Commander of the Center Army on all four sides.

sentences.zh: 及從入關，拜太宰、錄尚書事。

translations.literal: When he followed into Guan, he was appointed Grand Preceptor and Recorder of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When he followed into Guan, he was appointed Grand Preceptor and Recorder of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 孝武崩，丞相、略陽公宇文泰率群公卿士奉表勸進，三讓乃許焉。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu died, Chancellor Duke of Lueyang Yuwen Tai led the lords and ministers in presenting a memorial urging accession; after three refusals he consented.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaowu died, Chancellor Duke of Lueyang Yuwen Tai led the lords and ministers in presenting a memorial urging accession; after three refusals he consented.

sentences.zh: 大統元年春正月戊申，皇帝即位於城西，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the first year of Datong, on wushen, the Emperor took the throne west of the city, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the first year of Datong, on wushen day the Emperor took the throne west of the city, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name.

sentences.zh: 追尊皇考為文景皇帝，皇妣楊氏為皇后。

translations.literal: The late Emperor, the Emperor's father, was posthumously honored as Emperor Wenjing; Lady Yang, the Emperor's mother, as Empress.
translations.idiomatic: The late Emperor, the Emperor's father, was posthumously honored as Emperor Wenjing; Lady Yang, the Emperor's mother, as Empress.

sentences.zh: 己酉，進丞相、略陽公宇文泰都督中外諸軍、錄尚書事、大行臺，改封安定郡公。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Chancellor Duke of Lueyang Yuwen Tai was advanced to Area Commander of all armies within and without, Recorder of the Department of State Affairs, and Grand Mobile Secretariat, and his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Anding.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Chancellor Duke of Lueyang Yuwen Tai was advanced to Area Commander of all armies within and without, Recorder of the Department of State Affairs, and Grand Mobile Secretariat, and his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Anding.

sentences.zh: 以尚書令斛斯椿為太保，廣平王贊為司徒。

translations.literal: Director of the Department of State Affairs Husu Chun was made Grand Guardian; Prince of Guangping Zan was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: Director of the Department of State Affairs Husu Chun was made Grand Guardian; Prince of Guangping Zan was made Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，立妃乙氏為皇后，立皇子欽為皇太子。

translations.literal: On yimao, Consort Yi was established as Empress and the prince Qin as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Consort Yi was established as Empress and the prince Qin as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以廣陵王欣為太傅，以儀同三司万俟壽樂幹為司空。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Prince of Guangling Xin was made Grand Tutor; Wan Qishoulegan, Commissioner Equal to the Third Rank, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Prince of Guangling Xin was made Grand Tutor; Wan Qishoulegan, Commissioner Equal to the Third Rank, was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 東魏將侯景攻陷荊州。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei General Hou Jing attacked and took Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wei General Hou Jing attacked and took Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 二月，前南青州刺史大野拔斬兗州刺史樊子鵠，以州降東魏。

translations.literal: In the second month, former Southern Qing Regional Inspector Daye Ba beheaded Yan Regional Inspector Fan Zihong and surrendered the province to Eastern Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month former Southern Qing Regional Inspector Daye Ba beheaded Yan Regional Inspector Fan Zihong and surrendered the province to Eastern Wei.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，降罪人。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, criminals were pardoned to lower degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, criminals were pardoned to lower degrees.

sentences.zh: 加安定公宇文泰位柱國。

translations.literal: Duke of Anding Yuwen Tai was advanced to Pillar of State.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Anding Yuwen Tai was advanced to Pillar of State.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，以開府儀同三司念賢為太尉，以司空万俟壽樂幹為司徒；

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Nianxian, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Grand Commandant; Wan Qishoulegan, Minister of Works, was made Minister over the Masses;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn Nianxian, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Grand Commandant; Wan Qishoulegan, Minister of Works, was made Minister over the Masses;

sentences.zh: 以開府儀同三司越勒肱為司空。

translations.literal: and Yuelegu, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: and Yuelegu, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 梁州刺史元羅以州降梁。

translations.literal: Yuan Luo, Regional Inspector of Liang, surrendered the province to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Luo, Regional Inspector of Liang, surrendered the province to Liang.

sentences.zh: 九月，有司詔煎禦香澤，須錢萬貫。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the authorities were ordered to decoct imperial fragrant ointment, requiring ten thousand strings of cash.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the authorities were ordered to decoct imperial fragrant ointment, requiring ten thousand strings of cash.

sentences.zh: 帝以軍旅在外，停之。

translations.literal: The Emperor, because armies were abroad, halted it.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor, because armies were abroad, halted it.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，太師、上黨王長孫承業薨。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Grand Preceptor and Prince of Shangdang Changsun Chengye died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Grand Preceptor and Prince of Shangdang Changsun Chengye died.

sentences.zh: 十二月，以太尉念賢為太傅，以河州刺史梁景睿為太尉。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Grand Commandant Nianxian was made Grand Tutor; Liang Jingrui, Regional Inspector of He, was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Grand Commandant Nianxian was made Grand Tutor; Liang Jingrui, Regional Inspector of He, was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 三年春二月，槐里獲神璽，大赦。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring in the third year, a divine seal was obtained at Huaili and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring in the third year a divine seal was obtained at Huaili and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，太傅斛斯椿薨。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Grand Tutor Husu Chun died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Grand Tutor Husu Chun died.

sentences.zh: 五月，以廣陵王欣為太宰，賀拔勝為太師。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Prince of Guangling Xin was made Grand Preceptor; Heba Sheng was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Prince of Guangling Xin was made Grand Preceptor; Heba Sheng was made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 六月，以司空、扶風王孚為太保，以太尉梁景睿為太傅，以司徒、廣平王贊為太尉，以開府儀同三司王盟為司空。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Prince of Fufeng Fu, Minister of Works, was made Grand Guardian; Grand Commandant Liang Jingrui was made Grand Tutor; Prince of Guangping Zan, Minister over the Masses, was made Grand Commandant; Wang Meng, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Prince of Fufeng Fu, Minister of Works, was made Grand Guardian; Grand Commandant Liang Jingrui was made Grand Tutor; Prince of Guangping Zan, Minister over the Masses, was made Grand Commandant; Wang Meng, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，安定公宇文泰大破東魏軍於沙苑，拜泰柱國大將軍。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Duke of Anding Yuwen Tai inflicted a great defeat on the Eastern Wei army at Shayuan and was appointed Pillar of State Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Duke of Anding Yuwen Tai inflicted a great defeat on the Eastern Wei army at Shayuan and was appointed Pillar of State Grand General.

sentences.zh: 十二月，司徒李叔仁自涼州通使於東魏，建昌太守賀蘭植攻斬之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Minister over the Masses Li Shuren sent envoys from Liangzhou to Eastern Wei; Jianchang Regional Administrator Helan Zhi attacked and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Minister over the Masses Li Shuren sent envoys from Liangzhou to Eastern Wei; Jianchang Regional Administrator Helan Zhi attacked and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月辛酉，拜天於清暉室，終帝世遂為常。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, on xinyou, Heaven was worshiped in the Hall of Clear Radiance; through the Emperor's reign this became regular.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, on xinyou day Heaven was worshiped in the Hall of Clear Radiance; through the Emperor's reign this became regular.

sentences.zh: 二月，東魏攻陷南汾、潁、豫、廣四州。

translations.literal: In the second month, Eastern Wei attacked and took the four provinces of Nanfen, Ying, Yu, and Guang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Eastern Wei attacked and took the four provinces of Nanfen, Ying, Yu, and Guang.

sentences.zh: 廢皇后乙氏。

translations.literal: Empress Yi was deposed.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Yi was deposed.

sentences.zh: 三月，立蠕蠕女郁久閭氏為皇后，大赦。

translations.literal: In the third month, a Rouran woman of the Yujiulü clan was established as Empress and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month a Rouran woman of the Yujiulü clan was established as Empress and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 以司空王盟為司徒。

translations.literal: Wang Meng, Minister of Works, was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Meng, Minister of Works, was made Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，東魏將侯景等圍洛陽，帝與安定公宇文泰東伐。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Eastern Wei Generals Hou Jing and others besieged Luoyang; the Emperor with Duke of Anding Yuwen Tai campaigned east.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn Eastern Wei Generals Hou Jing and others besieged Luoyang; the Emperor with Duke of Anding Yuwen Tai campaigned east.

sentences.zh: 九月，車駕至自東伐。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the imperial carriage returned from the eastern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the imperial carriage returned from the eastern campaign.

sentences.zh: 以撫軍將軍梁定為南洮州刺史，安西蕃。

translations.literal: Pacifying-Army General Liang Ding was made Regional Inspector of Southern Tao and pacified the western barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Pacifying-Army General Liang Ding was made Regional Inspector of Southern Tao and pacified the western barbarians.

sentences.zh: 五年春二月，赦京城內。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring of the fifth year, those within the capital were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring of the fifth year those within the capital were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，以開府儀同三司李弼為司空。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, Li Bi, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer Li Bi, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 免妓樂雜役之徒，皆從編戶。

translations.literal: Courtesans, musicians, and miscellaneous corvée persons were all released to regular household registers.
translations.idiomatic: Courtesans, musicians, and miscellaneous corvée persons were all released to regular household registers.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，詔自今恒以朔望親閱京師見禁囚徒。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, an edict ordered that from now on, on the first and fifteenth of the month, the Emperor would personally review prisoners held in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn an edict ordered that from now on, on the first and fifteenth of the month, the Emperor would personally review prisoners held in the capital.

sentences.zh: 以司空、扶風王孚為太尉。

translations.literal: Prince of Fufeng Fu, Minister of Works, was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Fufeng Fu, Minister of Works, was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，於陽武門外縣鼓，置紙筆，以求得失。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, a drum was hung outside the Yangwu Gate and paper and brush set out to seek what was right and wrong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter a drum was hung outside the Yangwu Gate and paper and brush set out to seek what was right and wrong.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月庚戌，朝群臣。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, on gengxu, the Emperor held court with the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, on gengxu day the Emperor held court with the ministers.

sentences.zh: 自西遷至此，禮樂始備。

translations.literal: From the western removal until now, rites and music were first complete.
translations.idiomatic: From the western removal until now, rites and music were first complete.

sentences.zh: 太尉、扶風王孚薨。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant and Prince of Fufeng Fu died.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant and Prince of Fufeng Fu died.

sentences.zh: 二月，鑄五銖錢。

translations.literal: In the second month, five-zhu coins were cast.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month five-zhu coins were cast.

sentences.zh: 降罪人。

translations.literal: Criminals were pardoned to lower degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Criminals were pardoned to lower degrees.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，太師念賢薨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, Grand Preceptor Nianxian died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter Grand Preceptor Nianxian died.

sentences.zh: 七年春二月，幽州刺史、順陽王仲景以罪賜死。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring of the seventh year, Zhang Zhongjing, Regional Inspector of You and Prince of Shunyang, was granted death for a crime.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring of the seventh year Zhang Zhongjing, Regional Inspector of You and Prince of Shunyang, was granted death for a crime.

sentences.zh: 三月，夏州刺史劉平謀反，大都督於謹討禽之。

translations.literal: In the third month, Liu Ping, Regional Inspector of Xia, plotted rebellion; Area Commander Yu Jin campaigned against and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Liu Ping, Regional Inspector of Xia, plotted rebellion; Area Commander Yu Jin campaigned against and captured him.

sentences.zh: 秋九月，詔班政事之法六條。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn, an edict promulgated the six articles of the law of government.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn an edict promulgated the six articles of the law of government.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，叛羌梁定徒黨屯於赤水城，秦州刺史獨孤信擊平之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, remnant Qiang followers of Liang Ding encamped at Chishui City; Dugu Xin, Regional Inspector of Qin, attacked and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter remnant Qiang followers of Liang Ding encamped at Chishui City; Dugu Xin, Regional Inspector of Qin, attacked and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 尚書奏班十二條制。

translations.literal: The Department of State Affairs memorialized promulgating the twelve-article regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Department of State Affairs memorialized promulgating the twelve-article regulations.

sentences.zh: 十二月，御憑雲觀。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Emperor visited the Cloud-Reliant Observatory.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Emperor visited the Cloud-Reliant Observatory.

sentences.zh: 引見諸王，敘家人之禮。

translations.literal: He summoned the princes and observed the rites of family.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned the princes and observed the rites of family.

sentences.zh: 手詔為宗誡十條以賜之。

translations.literal: By hand he drafted ten articles of clan admonition and bestowed them.
translations.idiomatic: By hand he drafted ten articles of clan admonition and bestowed them.

sentences.zh: 八年春三月，初置六軍。

translations.literal: In the third month of spring of the eighth year the Six Armies were first established.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of spring of the eighth year the Six Armies were first established.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，鄯善王兄鄯朱那率眾內附。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Shazhuna, elder brother of the King of Shanshan, led his masses to submit inward.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Shazhuna, elder brother of the King of Shanshan, led his masses to submit inward.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，以太尉王盟為太保。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, Grand Commandant Wang Meng was made Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn Grand Commandant Wang Meng was made Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，詔皇太子鎮河東。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter an edict ordered the crown prince to garrison Hedong.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter an edict ordered the crown prince to garrison Hedong.

sentences.zh: 十二月，行幸華州，起萬壽殿於沙苑北。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the Emperor traveled to Hua Province and built the Hall of Long Life north of Shayuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the Emperor traveled to Hua Province and built the Hall of Long Life north of Shayuan.

sentences.zh: 九年春正月，降罪人。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the ninth year criminals were pardoned to lower degrees.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the ninth year criminals were pardoned to lower degrees.

sentences.zh: 禁中外及從母兄弟姊妹為婚。

translations.literal: Marriage was forbidden within and without the court among brothers and sisters born of the same mother.
translations.idiomatic: Marriage was forbidden within and without the court among brothers and sisters born of the same mother.

sentences.zh: 閏月，車駕至自華州。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month the imperial carriage returned from Hua Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month the imperial carriage returned from Hua Province.

sentences.zh: 二月，東魏北豫州刺史高仲密據武牢內附，以仲密為侍中、司徒，封勃海郡公。

translations.literal: In the second month, Gao Zhongmi, Northern Yu Regional Inspector of Eastern Wei, held Wulao and submitted inward; Zhongmi was made Palace Attendant and Minister over the Masses and enfeoffed as Duke of Bohai.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Gao Zhongmi, Northern Yu Regional Inspector of Eastern Wei, held Wulao and submitted inward; Zhongmi was made Palace Attendant and Minister over the Masses and enfeoffed as Duke of Bohai.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，大赦。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 以太保王盟為太傅，以太尉、廣平王贊為司空。

translations.literal: Grand Guardian Wang Meng was made Grand Tutor; Grand Commandant and Prince of Guangping Zan was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Guardian Wang Meng was made Grand Tutor; Grand Commandant and Prince of Guangping Zan was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月，以司空李弼為太尉。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, Li Bi, Minister of Works, was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter Li Bi, Minister of Works, was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月甲子，詔公卿已下，每月上封事三條，極言得失。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the tenth year, on jiazi, an edict ordered dukes and ministers downward to submit three sealed memorials each month, speaking fully of gains and losses.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the tenth year, on jiazi day an edict ordered dukes and ministers downward to submit three sealed memorials each month, speaking fully of gains and losses.

sentences.zh: 刺史二千石銅墨已上，有讜言嘉謀，勿有所諱。

translations.literal: Regional inspectors, two-thousand-bushel officials, and those bearing bronze seals and ink above them, if they had loyal words or fine plans, were not to withhold them.
translations.idiomatic: Regional inspectors, two-thousand-bushel officials, and those bearing bronze seals and ink above them, if they had loyal words or fine plans, were not to withhold them.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，太師賀拔勝薨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, Grand Preceptor Heba Sheng died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer Grand Preceptor Heba Sheng died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，更權衡度量。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn weights and measures were revised.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn weights and measures were revised.

sentences.zh: 十一年夏五月，太傳王盟薨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer of the eleventh year, Grand Tutor Wang Meng died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer Grand Tutor Wang Meng died.

sentences.zh: 詔諸鞫大辟獄，皆命三公覆審，然後加刑。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that in all capital cases the Three Excellencies must review again before punishment was applied.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that in all capital cases the Three Excellencies must review again before punishment was applied.

sentences.zh: 冬，始築圓丘於城南。

translations.literal: In winter construction of the Circular Mound south of the city was begun.
translations.idiomatic: In winter construction of the Circular Mound south of the city was begun.

sentences.zh: 封皇子儉。

translations.literal: The imperial son Jian was enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial son Jian was enfeoffed.

sentences.zh: 十二年春二月，涼州刺史宇文仲和反，秦州刺史獨孤信討平之。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring of the twelfth year, Yuwen Zhonghe, Regional Inspector of Liang, rebelled; Dugu Xin, Regional Inspector of Qin, campaigned and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring of the twelfth year Yuwen Zhonghe, Regional Inspector of Liang, rebelled; Dugu Xin, Regional Inspector of Qin, campaigned and pacified him.

sentences.zh: 三月，鑄五銖錢。

translations.literal: In the third month five-zhu coins were cast.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month five-zhu coins were cast.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，詔女年不滿十三以上，勿得以嫁。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer an edict said girls not yet thirteen years of age might not be given in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer an edict said girls not yet thirteen years of age might not be given in marriage.

sentences.zh: 秋九月，東魏勃海王高歡攻玉壁，晉州刺史韋孝寬力戰禦之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of autumn, Gao Huan, Prince of Bohai of Eastern Wei, attacked Yubi; Wei Xiaokuan, Regional Inspector of Jin, fought hard to defend.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of autumn Gao Huan, Prince of Bohai of Eastern Wei, attacked Yubi; Wei Xiaokuan, Regional Inspector of Jin, fought hard to defend.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月，歡燒營而退。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter Huan burned the camps and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter Huan burned the camps and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月，赦潁、豫、廣、北、洛、東荊、襄等七州。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fourteenth year, the seven provinces of Ying, Yu, Guang, Bei, Luo, Eastern Jing, and Xiang were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the fourteenth year the seven provinces of Ying, Yu, Guang, Bei, Luo, Eastern Jing, and Xiang were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 以開府儀同三司趙貴為司空。

translations.literal: Zhao Gui, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Gui, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 皇孫生，大赦。

translations.literal: An imperial grandson was born and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: An imperial grandson was born and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，以安定公宇文泰為太師，廣陵王欣為太傅，太尉李弼為大宗伯，前太尉趙貴為大司寇，以司空于謹為大司空。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, Duke of Anding Yuwen Tai was made Grand Preceptor; Prince of Guangling Xin was made Grand Tutor; Grand Commandant Li Bi was made Grand Herald; former Grand Commandant Zhao Gui was made Grand Minister of Justice; Yu Jin, Minister of Works, was made Grand Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer Duke of Anding Yuwen Tai was made Grand Preceptor; Prince of Guangling Xin was made Grand Tutor; Grand Commandant Li Bi was made Grand Herald; former Grand Commandant Zhao Gui was made Grand Minister of Justice; Yu Jin, Minister of Works, was made Grand Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 十五年己巳五月，侯景殺梁武帝。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, jisi, of the fifteenth year Hou Jing killed Emperor Wu of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, jisi, of the fifteenth year Hou Jing killed Emperor Wu of Liang.

sentences.zh: 初，詔諸代人太和中改姓者，並令復舊。

translations.literal: Earlier an edict had ordered those of alien descent who had changed surnames in the Taihe era to restore the old.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier an edict had ordered those of alien descent who had changed surnames in the Taihe era to restore the old.

sentences.zh: 六月，東魏勃海王高澄攻陷潁川。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Gao Cheng, Prince of Bohai of Eastern Wei, attacked and took Yingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Gao Cheng, Prince of Bohai of Eastern Wei, attacked and took Yingchuan.

sentences.zh: 秋八月，盜殺東魏勃海王高澄。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn bandits killed Gao Cheng, Prince of Bohai of Eastern Wei.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn bandits killed Gao Cheng, Prince of Bohai of Eastern Wei.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月，封梁雍州剌史、岳陽王蕭察為梁王。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, Xiao Cha, Liang Regional Inspector of Yong and Prince of Yueyang, was enfeoffed as King of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter Xiao Cha, Liang Regional Inspector of Yong and Prince of Yueyang, was enfeoffed as King of Liang.

sentences.zh: 十六年夏四月，封皇子儒為燕王，公為吳王。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the sixteenth year the imperial sons Ru and Gong were enfeoffed as Prince of Yan and Prince of Wu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer of the sixteenth year the imperial sons Ru and Gong were enfeoffed as Prince of Yan and Prince of Wu.

sentences.zh: 五月，東魏靜帝遜位於齊。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the Deposed Emperor of Eastern Wei yielded the throne to Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Deposed Emperor of Eastern Wei yielded the throne to Qi.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，安定公宇文泰東伐，至恒農。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn Duke of Anding Yuwen Tai campaigned east to Hengnong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn Duke of Anding Yuwen Tai campaigned east to Hengnong.

sentences.zh: 齊師不出，乃還。

translations.literal: The Qi army did not come out, and he returned.
translations.idiomatic: The Qi army did not come out, and he returned.

sentences.zh: 九月，大赦。

translations.literal: In the ninth month a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 十七年春三月庚戌，帝崩於乾安殿，時年四十五。

translations.literal: In the third month of spring of the seventeenth year, on gengxu, the Emperor died in the Hall of Qian'an, aged forty-five.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of spring of the seventeenth year, on gengxu day the Emperor died in the Hall of Qian'an, aged forty-five.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚辰，葬於永陵，上謚曰文皇帝。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on gengchen, he was buried at Yongling; his posthumous title is Emperor Wen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on gengchen day he was buried at Yongling; his posthumous title is Emperor Wen.

sentences.zh: 帝性強果，始為太尉時，侍中高隆之恃勃海王高歡之黨，驕狎公卿。

translations.literal: The Emperor was strong and resolute by nature. When he was first Grand Commandant, Palace Attendant Gao Longzhi, relying on the faction of Prince of Bohai Gao Huan, was arrogant toward dukes and ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was strong and resolute by nature. When he was first Grand Commandant, Palace Attendant Gao Longzhi, relying on the faction of Prince of Bohai Gao Huan, was arrogant toward dukes and ministers.

sentences.zh: 因公會，帝勸酒不飲，怒而毆之。

translations.literal: At a public gathering the Emperor urged wine and Longzhi would not drink; enraged, the Emperor beat him.
translations.idiomatic: At a public gathering the Emperor urged wine and Longzhi would not drink; enraged, the Emperor beat him.

sentences.zh: 罵曰：「鎮兵，何敢爾也！

translations.literal: He cursed: "Garrison soldier—how dare you!"
translations.idiomatic: He cursed: "Garrison soldier—how dare you!"

sentences.zh: 」孝武以歡故，免帝太尉。

translations.literal: Because of Huan, Emperor Xiaowu dismissed the Emperor from Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Because of Huan, Emperor Xiaowu dismissed the Emperor from Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 歸第，命羽林守衛，月餘復位。

translations.literal: He returned to his residence; imperial guards were ordered; after more than a month he was restored.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to his residence; imperial guards were ordered; after more than a month he was restored.

sentences.zh: 及歡將改葬其父，朝廷追贈太師，百僚會吊者盡拜。

translations.literal: When Huan was about to rebury his father, the court posthumously honored him as Grand Preceptor; all officials attending the mourning bowed.
translations.idiomatic: When Huan was about to rebury his father, the court posthumously honored him as Grand Preceptor; all officials attending the mourning bowed.

sentences.zh: 帝獨不屈，曰：「安有生三公而拜贈太師耶！

translations.literal: The Emperor alone would not bend and said: "How can a living Three Excellency bow to a posthumous Grand Preceptor!"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor alone would not bend and said: "How can a living Three Excellency bow to a posthumous Grand Preceptor!"

sentences.zh: 」及躋大位，權歸周室。

translations.literal: When he ascended the great throne, power returned to the Zhou house.
translations.idiomatic: When he ascended the great throne, power returned to the Zhou house.

sentences.zh: 嘗登逍遙觀望嵯峨山，因謂左右曰：「望此，令人有脫屣之意。

translations.literal: Once he ascended the Leisure Observatory and gazed at the lofty Cui'e Mountains; he said to those about him: "Gazing at this makes one wish to cast off one's shoes.
translations.idiomatic: Once he ascended the Leisure Observatory and gazed at the lofty peaks of Cui'e; he said to those about him: "Gazing at this makes one wish to cast off one's shoes.

sentences.zh: 若使朕年五十，便委政儲宮，尋山餌藥，不能一日萬機也。

translations.literal: If I reach fifty, I shall entrust government to the heir and seek the mountains to take elixirs—I could not bear ten thousand affairs in a single day."
translations.idiomatic: If I reach fifty, I shall entrust the realm to the heir and seek the mountains for elixirs—I could not bear ten thousand affairs in a single day."

sentences.zh: 」既而大運未終，竟保天祿云。

translations.literal: Yet the great destiny was not ended, and in the end he preserved Heaven's mandate.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the great destiny was not ended, and in the end he preserved Heaven's mandate.

sentences.zh: 廢帝欽

translations.literal: The Deposed Emperor Qin.
translations.idiomatic: The Deposed Emperor Qin.

sentences.zh: 廢帝諱欽，文皇帝之長子也。

translations.literal: The Deposed Emperor, taboo name Qin, was the eldest son of Emperor Wen.
translations.idiomatic: The Deposed Emperor, taboo name Qin, was the eldest son of Emperor Wen.

sentences.zh: 母曰乙皇后。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Yi.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Yi.

sentences.zh: 大統元年正月乙卯，立為皇太子。

translations.literal: In the first year of Datong, first month, yimao, he was established as crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Datong, first month, yimao day he was established as crown prince.

sentences.zh: 十七年三月，即皇帝位。

translations.literal: In the third month of the seventeenth year he took the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the seventeenth year he took the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 是月，梁邵陵王蕭綸侵安陸，大將軍楊忠討禽之。

translations.literal: That month, Xiao Lun, Prince of Shaoling of Liang, invaded Anlu; Grand General Yang Zhong campaigned and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xiao Lun, Prince of Shaoling of Liang, invaded Anlu; Grand General Yang Zhong campaigned and captured him.

sentences.zh: 元年冬十一月，梁湘東王蕭繹討侯景，禽之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter of the first year, Xiao Yi, Prince of Xiangdong of Liang, campaigned against Hou Jing and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter of the first year Xiao Yi, Prince of Xiangdong of Liang, campaigned against Hou Jing and captured him.

sentences.zh: 遣其舍人魏彥來告，仍嗣位於江陵。

translations.literal: He sent his Retainer Wei Yan to report and then succeeded to the throne at Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: He sent his Retainer Wei Yan to report and then succeeded to the throne at Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 二年秋八月，大將軍尉遲迥克成都，劍南平。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn of the second year, Grand General Yuchi Jiong took Chengdu and Jiannan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn of the second year Grand General Yuchi Jiong took Chengdu and Jiannan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，安定公宇文泰殺尚書元烈。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, Duke of Anding Yuwen Tai killed Director of the Department of State Affairs Yuan Lie.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter Duke of Anding Yuwen Tai killed Director of the Department of State Affairs Yuan Lie.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月，安定公宇文泰廢帝而立齊王廓。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the third year, Duke of Anding Yuwen Tai deposed the Emperor and installed Prince of Qi Kuo.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the third year Duke of Anding Yuwen Tai deposed the Emperor and installed Prince of Qi Kuo.

sentences.zh: 帝自元烈之誅，有怨言。

translations.literal: Since Yuan Lie's execution the Emperor had had resentful words.
translations.idiomatic: Since Yuan Lie's execution the Emperor had had resentful words.

sentences.zh: 淮安王育、廣平王贊等並垂泣諫，帝不聽，故及於辱。

translations.literal: Prince of Huai'an Yu, Prince of Guangping Zan, and others all wept and remonstrated; the Emperor would not listen, and therefore met disgrace.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Huai'an Yu, Prince of Guangping Zan, and others all wept and remonstrated; the Emperor would not listen, and therefore met disgrace.

sentences.zh: 恭皇帝諱廓，文皇之第四子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Gong, taboo name Kuo, was the fourth son of Emperor Wen.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gong, taboo name Kuo, was the fourth son of Emperor Wen.

sentences.zh: 大統十四年，封為齊王。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Datong he was enfeoffed as Prince of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Datong he was enfeoffed as Prince of Qi.

sentences.zh: 廢帝三年正月，即皇帝位，改元。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year of the Deposed Emperor he took the imperial throne and changed the era name.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year of the Deposed Emperor he took the imperial throne and changed the era name.

sentences.zh: 元年夏四月，蠕蠕乙旃達官寇廣武。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the first year, Yizhan Daguan of Rouran raided Guangwu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer of the first year Yizhan Daguan of Rouran raided Guangwu.

sentences.zh: 五月，柱國李弼追擊之，斬首數千級，收輜重而還。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Pillar of State Li Bi pursued and beheaded several thousand; he recovered baggage trains and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Pillar of State Li Bi pursued and beheaded several thousand; he recovered baggage trains and returned.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，魏師滅梁，戕梁元帝。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter the Wei army destroyed Liang and killed Emperor Yuan of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter the Wei army destroyed Liang and killed Emperor Yuan of Liang.

sentences.zh: 梁太尉王僧辯奉元帝子方智為王，承制，居建業。

translations.literal: Liang Grand Commandant Wang Sengbian installed Yuan Di's son Fangzhi as king, held the imperial seal, and resided at Jianye.
translations.idiomatic: Liang Grand Commandant Wang Sengbian installed Yuan Di's son Fangzhi as king, held the imperial seal, and resided at Jianye.

sentences.zh: 二年秋七月，梁太尉王僧辯納貞陽侯蕭明於齊，奉以為主。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn of the second year, Liang Grand Commandant Wang Sengbian received Marquis of Zhenyang Xiao Ming from Qi and installed him as ruler.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn of the second year Liang Grand Commandant Wang Sengbian received Marquis of Zhenyang Xiao Ming from Qi and installed him as ruler.

sentences.zh: 梁王方智為太子。

translations.literal: Liang King Fangzhi was made crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: Liang King Fangzhi was made crown prince.

sentences.zh: 九月，梁司空陳霸先殺僧辯，廢蕭明，復奉方智為帝。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Chen Baxian, Liang Minister of Works, killed Sengbian, deposed Xiao Ming, and again received Fangzhi as emperor.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Chen Baxian, Liang Minister of Works, killed Sengbian, deposed Xiao Ming, and again received Fangzhi as emperor.

sentences.zh: 是歲，梁廣州刺史王琳寇邊，大將軍豆盧寧帥師討之。

translations.literal: That year, Wang Lin, Liang Regional Inspector of Guang, raided the border; Grand General Dou Lu Ning led troops to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: That year Wang Lin, Liang Regional Inspector of Guang, raided the border; Grand General Dou Lu Ning led troops to campaign against him.

sentences.zh: 孝靜帝

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaojing.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaojing.

sentences.zh: 東魏孝靜皇帝諱善見，清河文宣王亶之世子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaojing of Eastern Wei, taboo name Shan Jian, was the heir of Prince of Qinghe Wenxuan Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaojing of Eastern Wei, taboo name Shan Jian, was the heir of Prince of Qinghe Wenxuan Xuan.

sentences.zh: 母曰胡妃。

translations.literal: His mother was Consort Hu.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Consort Hu.

sentences.zh: 永熙三年八月，拜開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year of Yongxi he was appointed Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year of Yongxi he was appointed Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝既入關，勃海王高歡乃與百僚會議，推帝以奉明帝之後，時年十一。

translations.literal: After Emperor Xiaowu entered Guan, Prince of Bohai Gao Huan deliberated with the hundred officials and installed the Emperor to continue after Emperor Ming, aged eleven at the time.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Xiaowu entered Guan Prince of Bohai Gao Huan deliberated with the hundred officials and installed the Emperor to continue after Emperor Ming, aged eleven at the time.

sentences.zh: 天平元年冬十月丙寅，皇帝即位於城東北。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter of the first year of Tianping, on bingyin, the Emperor took the throne northeast of the city.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter of the first year of Tianping, on bingyin day the Emperor took the throne northeast of the city.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以太師、趙郡王諶為大司馬；

translations.literal: On gengwu, Grand Preceptor and Prince of Zhao Yuan Chen was made Grand Marshal;
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day Grand Preceptor and Prince of Zhao Yuan Chen was made Grand Marshal;

sentences.zh: 以司空、咸陽王坦為太尉；

translations.literal: Grand Commandant and Prince of Xianyang Tan was made Grand Commandant;
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant and Prince of Xianyang Tan was made Grand Commandant;

sentences.zh: 以開府儀同三司高盛為司徒；

translations.literal: Gao Sheng, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Minister over the Masses;
translations.idiomatic: Gao Sheng, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Minister over the Masses;

sentences.zh: 以開府儀同三司高昂為司空。

translations.literal: and Gao Ang, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: and Gao Ang, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 壬申，享太廟。

translations.literal: On renshen sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day sacrifice was offered at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 丙子，車駕北遷於鄴。

translations.literal: On bingzi the imperial carriage moved north to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the imperial carriage moved north to Ye.

sentences.zh: 詔勃海王高歡留後部分。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Prince of Bohai Gao Huan to remain behind and hold the rear sections.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Prince of Bohai Gao Huan to remain behind and hold the rear sections.

sentences.zh: 改司州為洛州。

translations.literal: Sizhou was changed to Luozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Sizhou was changed to Luozhou.

sentences.zh: 以尚書令元弼為儀同三司、洛州刺史，鎮洛陽。

translations.literal: Yuan Bi, Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Commissioner Equal to the Third Rank and Regional Inspector of Luo, garrisoning Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Bi, Director of the Department of State Affairs, was made Commissioner Equal to the Third Rank and Regional Inspector of Luo, garrisoning Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 十一月兗州刺史樊子鵠、南青州刺史大野拔據瑕丘反。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Fan Zihong, Regional Inspector of Yan, and Daye Ba, former Southern Qing Regional Inspector, seized Xiaqiu in revolt.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Fan Zihong, Regional Inspector of Yan, and Daye Ba, former Southern Qing Regional Inspector, seized Xiaqiu in revolt.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，車駕至鄴，居北城相州之廨。

translations.literal: On gengyin the imperial carriage reached Ye and resided in the offices of the Xiangzhou governor in the northern city.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the imperial carriage reached Ye and resided in the offices of the Xiangzhou governor in the northern city.

sentences.zh: 改相州刺史為司州牧，魏郡太守為魏尹。

translations.literal: The Xiangzhou regional inspector was changed to Governor of Sizhou; the Wei commandery administrator was changed to Wei Yin.
translations.idiomatic: The Xiangzhou regional inspector was changed to Governor of Sizhou; the Wei commandery administrator was changed to Wei Yin.

sentences.zh: 徙鄴舊人西徑百里，以居新遷人。

translations.literal: The old population of Ye was moved one hundred li west to house the newly moved people.
translations.idiomatic: The old population of Ye was moved one hundred li west to house the newly moved people.

sentences.zh: 分鄴置臨漳縣。

translations.literal: Linzhang County was established from Ye.
translations.idiomatic: From Ye, Linzhang County was established.

sentences.zh: 以魏郡、林慮、廣平、陽丘、汲郡、黎陽、東濮陽、清河、廣宗等郡為皇畿。

translations.literal: The commanderies of Wei, Linyu, Guangping, Yangqiu, Ji, Liyang, Eastern Puyang, Qinghe, Guangzong, and others were made the imperial domain.
translations.idiomatic: The commanderies of Wei, Linyu, Guangping, Yangqiu, Ji, Liyang, Eastern Puyang, Qinghe, Guangzong, and others were made the imperial domain.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯，燕郡王賀拔允薨。

translations.literal: On dingmao in the twelfth month, Prince of Yancheng Heba Yun died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the twelfth month Prince of Yancheng Heba Yun died.

sentences.zh: 庚午，詔內外戒嚴，百司悉依舊章，從容雅服，不得以務衫從事。

translations.literal: On gengwu an edict imposed martial alert within and without; all offices were to follow old regulations and wear dignified dress, and might not conduct business in service jackets.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day an edict imposed martial alert within and without; all offices were to follow old regulations and wear dignified dress, and might not conduct business in service jackets.

sentences.zh: 丙子，進侍中封隆之等五人為大使，巡喻天下。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Palace Attendant Feng Longzhi and four others were advanced as grand ambassadors to tour and instruct the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Palace Attendant Feng Longzhi and four others were advanced as grand ambassadors to tour and instruct the realm.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，赦畿內。

translations.literal: On dingchou the metropolitan circuit was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the metropolitan circuit was pardoned.

sentences.zh: 閏月，梁以元慶和為魏王，入據平瀨鄉。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month Liang installed Yuan Qinghe as King of Wei; he entered and seized Pingliao Township.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month Liang installed Yuan Qinghe as King of Wei; he entered and seized Pingliao Township.

sentences.zh: 孝武崩於長安。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowu died at Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowu died at Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 初置四中郎將，於礓石橋置東中，蒲泉置西中，濟北置南中，洺水置北中。

translations.literal: The four Gentlemen-Generals of the Center were first established: Eastern Center at Qiaoshi Bridge, Western Center at Pu Spring, Southern Center at Jibei, Northern Center at Ming River.
translations.idiomatic: The four Gentlemen-Generals of the Center were first established: Eastern Center at Qiaoshi Bridge, Western Center at Pu Spring, Southern Center at Jibei, Northern Center at Ming River.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙亥，兼尚書右僕射、東南道行臺元晏討元慶和，破走之。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, on yihai, Acting Right Vice Director and Southeastern Circuit Mobile Secretariat Yuan Yan campaigned against Yuan Qinghe, defeated him, and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the second year, on yihai day Acting Right Vice Director and Southeastern Circuit Mobile Secretariat Yuan Yan campaigned against Yuan Qinghe, defeated him, and drove him off.

sentences.zh: 二月壬午，以太尉、咸陽王坦為太傅，以司州牧、西河王悽為太尉。

translations.literal: On renyang, Grand Commandant and Prince of Xianyang Tan was made Grand Tutor; Governor of Sizhou and Prince of Xihe Qi was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On renyang day Grand Commandant and Prince of Xianyang Tan was made Grand Tutor; Governor of Sizhou and Prince of Xihe Qi was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 己丑，前南青州刺史大野拔斬樊子鵠以降，兗州平。

translations.literal: On jichou, former Southern Qing Regional Inspector Daye Ba beheaded Fan Zihong and surrendered; Yan Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day former Southern Qing Regional Inspector Daye Ba beheaded Fan Zihong and surrendered; Yan Province was pacified.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，梁司州刺史陳慶之寇豫州，刺史堯雄擊走之。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Chen Qingzhi, Liang Regional Inspector of Si, raided Yu Province; Regional Inspector Yao Xiong drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Chen Qingzhi, Liang Regional Inspector of Si, raided Yu Province; Regional Inspector Yao Xiong drove him off.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，以司徒高盛為太尉，以司空高昂為司徒，濟陰王暉業為司空。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Gao Sheng was made Grand Commandant; Gao Ang was made Minister over the Masses; Prince of Jiyin Huiye was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Gao Sheng was made Grand Commandant; Gao Ang was made Minister over the Masses; Prince of Jiyin Huiye was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 勃海王高歡討平山胡劉蠡升。

translations.literal: Prince of Bohai Gao Huan campaigned and pacified the mountain Hu Liu Lusheng.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Bohai Gao Huan campaigned and pacified the mountain Hu Liu Lusheng.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以旱故，詔京邑及諸州郡縣收瘞骸骨。

translations.literal: On xinwei, because of drought an edict ordered the capital and all commanderies and counties to gather and bury exposed bones.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day because of drought an edict ordered the capital and all commanderies and counties to gather and bury exposed bones.

sentences.zh: 是春，高麗、契丹並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That spring Goguryeo and Khitan both sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That spring Goguryeo and Khitan both sent envoys to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，前青州刺史侯梁反，攻掠青、齊。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, former Qing Regional Inspector Hou Liang rebelled and raided Qing and Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer former Qing Regional Inspector Hou Liang rebelled and raided Qing and Qi.

sentences.zh: 癸未，濟州刺史蔡俊討平之。

translations.literal: On guiwei, Regional Inspector of Ji Cai Jun campaigned and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Regional Inspector of Ji Cai Jun campaigned and pacified him.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，降京師見囚。

translations.literal: On renchen, prisoners held in the capital were pardoned to lower degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day prisoners held in the capital were pardoned to lower degrees.

sentences.zh: 夏五月，大旱。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer there was great drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer there was great drought.

sentences.zh: 勒城門殿門及省府寺署坊門澆人，不簡王公，無限日，得雨乃止。

translations.literal: At city gates, palace gates, and offices of provinces, directorates, agencies, wards, and gates, people were poured water without distinction of duke or prince, without limit of days, until rain came.
translations.idiomatic: At city gates, palace gates, and offices of provinces, directorates, agencies, wards, and gates, people were poured water without distinction of duke or prince, without limit of days, until rain came.

sentences.zh: 六月，元慶和寇南頓，豫州刺史堯雄大破之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Yuan Qinghe raided southern Dun; Regional Inspector of Yu Yao Xiong inflicted a great defeat on him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Yuan Qinghe raided southern Dun; Regional Inspector of Yu Yao Xiong inflicted a great defeat on him.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲戌，封汝南王悅孫綽為瑯邪王。

translations.literal: On jiaxu in the seventh month of autumn, Chuo, grandson of Prince of Runan Yue, was enfeoffed as Prince of Langye.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the seventh month of autumn Chuo, grandson of Prince of Runan Yue, was enfeoffed as Prince of Langye.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，司空、濟陰王暉業坐事免。

translations.literal: On xinmao in the eighth month, Prince of Jiyin Huiye, Minister of Works, was dismissed for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the eighth month Prince of Jiyin Huiye, Minister of Works, was dismissed for an offense.

sentences.zh: 甲午，發眾七萬六千人營新宮。

translations.literal: On jiawu, masses numbering seventy-six thousand were mobilized to build the new palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day masses numbering seventy-six thousand were mobilized to build the new palace.

sentences.zh: 九月丁巳，以開府儀同三司、襄城王旭為司空。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Gao Xu, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank and Prince of Xiangcheng, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Gao Xu, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank and Prince of Xiangcheng, was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月丁未，梁柳仲禮寇荊州，刺史王元擊破之。

translations.literal: On dingwei in the eleventh month of winter, Liu Zhongli of Liang raided Jing Province; Regional Inspector Wang Yuan defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the eleventh month of winter Liu Zhongli of Liang raided Jing Province; Regional Inspector Wang Yuan defeated him.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，祀圓丘。

translations.literal: On guichou sacrifice was offered at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day sacrifice was offered at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，閶闔門災。

translations.literal: On jiayin the Gate of Opening the Gate to All Directions caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Gate of Opening the Gate to All Directions caught fire.

sentences.zh: 龍見并州人家井中。

translations.literal: A dragon appeared in a well in a household in Bing Province.
translations.idiomatic: A dragon appeared in a well in a household in Bing Province.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬午，車駕狩於鄴東。

translations.literal: On renyang in the twelfth month the imperial carriage hunted east of Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On renyang in the twelfth month the imperial carriage hunted east of Ye.

sentences.zh: 甲午，文武百官量事各給祿。

translations.literal: On jiawu civil and military officials were each given salary according to measure.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day civil and military officials were each given salary according to measure.

sentences.zh: 是歲，西魏文帝大統元年也。

translations.literal: That year was the first year of Datong of Emperor Wen of Western Wei.
translations.idiomatic: That year was the first year of Datong of Emperor Wen of Western Wei.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸卯朔，饗群臣於前殿。

translations.literal: On the first day of the first month of spring of the third year, guimao, the Emperor feasted the ministers in the front hall.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, the first day of the first month of spring of the third year, the Emperor feasted the ministers in the front hall.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔百官舉士。

translations.literal: On wushen an edict ordered all officials to recommend scholars.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day an edict ordered all officials to recommend scholars.

sentences.zh: 舉不稱才者，兩免之。

translations.literal: Those whose recommendations did not match talent were twice dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Those whose recommendations did not match talent were twice dismissed.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未，梁光州刺史郝樹以州內附。

translations.literal: On dingwei, Hao Shu, Liang Regional Inspector of Guang, submitted the province inward.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Hao Shu, Liang Regional Inspector of Guang, submitted the province inward.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，加勃海王世子澄為尚書令、大行臺、大都督。

translations.literal: On dingyou, heir of Prince of Bohai Cheng was added as Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Mobile Secretariat, and Grand Area Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day heir of Prince of Bohai Cheng was added as Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Mobile Secretariat, and Grand Area Commander.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，以開府儀同三司、華山王鷙為大司馬。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Prince of Huashan Zhi, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Prince of Huashan Zhi, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，陽夏太守盧公纂據郡南叛，大都督元整破之。

translations.literal: On dingmao, Lu Gongzhuan, Regional Administrator of Yangxia, seized the commandery and rebelled south; Grand Commander Yuan Zheng defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Lu Gongzhuan, Regional Administrator of Yangxia, seized the commandery and rebelled south; Grand Commander Yuan Zheng defeated him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁酉，昌樂王誕薨。

translations.literal: On dingyou in the fourth month of summer, Prince of Changle Yan died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the fourth month of summer Prince of Changle Yan died.

sentences.zh: 五月癸卯，賜鰥寡孤獨貧窮者衣物各有差。

translations.literal: On guimao in the fifth month, widowers, orphans, the solitary, destitute, and poor were given clothing, each according to measure.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the fifth month widowers, orphans, the solitary, destitute, and poor were given clothing, each according to measure.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以錄尚書事、西河王悽為司州牧。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Prince of Xihe Qi, Recorder of the Department of State Affairs, was made Governor of Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Prince of Xihe Qi, Recorder of the Department of State Affairs, was made Governor of Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，太尉高盛薨。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Grand Commandant Gao Sheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day Grand Commandant Gao Sheng died.

sentences.zh: 六月辛巳，趙郡王諶薨。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Prince of Zhao Yuan Chen died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day Prince of Zhao Yuan Chen died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚子，大赦。

translations.literal: On gengzi in the seventh month of autumn a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the seventh month of autumn a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 梁夏州刺史田獨鞞、潁川防城都督劉鸞慶並以州內附。

translations.literal: Tian Dubian, Liang Regional Inspector of Xia, and Liu Luanqing, Defense Commander of Yingchuan, both submitted their provinces inward.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Dubian, Liang Regional Inspector of Xia, and Liu Luanqing, Defense Commander of Yingchuan, both submitted their provinces inward.

sentences.zh: 八月，并、泗、涿、建四州霜隕，大饑。

translations.literal: In the eighth month frost fell in Bing, Si, Zhuo, and Jian—four provinces—and there was great famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month frost fell in Bing, Si, Zhuo, and Jian—four provinces—and there was great famine.

sentences.zh: 九月壬寅，以定州刺史侯景兼尚書右僕射、南道行臺，節度諸軍南討。

translations.literal: On renyin, Hou Jing, Regional Inspector of Ding and Acting Right Vice Director and Southern Circuit Mobile Secretariat, was put in command of all armies campaigning south.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Hou Jing, Regional Inspector of Ding and Acting Right Vice Director and Southern Circuit Mobile Secretariat, was put in command of all armies campaigning south.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，平陽人路季禮聚眾反。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Lu Jili of Pingyang gathered a crowd in revolt.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Lu Jili of Pingyang gathered a crowd in revolt.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，御史中尉竇泰討平之。

translations.literal: On xinyou, Censor-in-Chief Dou Tai campaigned and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day Censor-in-Chief Dou Tai campaigned and pacified him.

translations.literal: Closing punctuation.
translations.idiomatic: End of entry.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊申，詔遣使巡檢河北流移饑人。

translations.literal: On wushen in the eleventh month of winter an edict dispatched envoys to inspect displaced and hungry people north of the Yellow River.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the eleventh month of winter an edict dispatched envoys to inspect displaced and hungry people north of the Yellow River.

sentences.zh: 侯景攻克梁楚州，獲刺史桓和。

translations.literal: Hou Jing took Liang Chu Province and captured Regional Inspector Huan He.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing took Liang Chu Province and captured Regional Inspector Huan He.

sentences.zh: 十二月，以并州刺史尉景為太保。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Wei Jing, Regional Inspector of Bing, was made Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Wei Jing, Regional Inspector of Bing, was made Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 辛未，遣使者板假老人官，百歲已下，各有差。

translations.literal: On xinwei envoys were sent to confer honorary offices on the aged, each according to rank for those one hundred years and below.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day envoys were sent to confer honorary offices on the aged, each according to rank for those one hundred years and below.

sentences.zh: 壬申，大司馬、清河王亶薨。

translations.literal: On renshen, Grand Marshal and Prince of Qinghe Xuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Grand Marshal and Prince of Qinghe Xuan died.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以太傅、咸陽王坦為太師。

translations.literal: On guisi, Grand Tutor and Prince of Xianyang Tan was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day Grand Tutor and Prince of Xianyang Tan was made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、勿吉並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Goguryeo and Wuji both sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Goguryeo and Wuji both sent envoys to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月，以汝陽王暹為錄尚書事。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, Prince of Ruyang Xian was made Recorder of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the fourth year Prince of Ruyang Xian was made Recorder of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 夏四月辛未，遷七帝神主入新廟。

translations.literal: On xinwei in the fourth month of summer the spirit tablets of the seven emperors were moved into the new temple.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the fourth month of summer the spirit tablets of the seven emperors were moved into the new temple.

sentences.zh: 大赦，內外百官普進一階。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed; officials within and without were universally advanced one rank.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed; officials within and without were universally advanced one rank.

sentences.zh: 先是，滎陽人張儉等聚眾反於大騩山，通西魏。

translations.literal: Earlier, Zhang Jian and others of Xingyang had gathered a crowd in revolt on Mount Daqi and communicated with Western Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier Zhang Jian and others of Xingyang had gathered a crowd in revolt on Mount Daqi and communicated with Western Wei.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，武衛將軍高元咸討破之。

translations.literal: On renchen, Martial Guard General Gao Yuancheng campaigned and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Martial Guard General Gao Yuancheng campaigned and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 六月己巳，幸華林園理訟。

translations.literal: On jisi the Emperor visited the Hualin Garden to judge lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the Emperor visited the Hualin Garden to judge lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 辛未，詔尚書掩骼埋胔，推錄囚徒。

translations.literal: On xinwei an edict ordered the Department of State Affairs to gather exposed bones and bury them and to review prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day an edict ordered the Department of State Affairs to gather exposed bones and bury them and to review prisoners.

sentences.zh: 壬午，閶闔門災。

translations.literal: On renyang the Gate of Opening the Gate to All Directions caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: On renyang day the Gate of Opening the Gate to All Directions caught fire.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，遣兼散騎常侍李楷聘於梁。

translations.literal: On jiachen in the seventh month of autumn, Acting Palace Attendant Li Kai was sent as envoy to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the seventh month of autumn Acting Palace Attendant Li Kai was sent as envoy to Liang.

sentences.zh: 八月，西魏克陜州，刺史李徽伯死之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Western Wei took Shan Province; Regional Inspector Li Huibo died in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Western Wei took Shan Province; Regional Inspector Li Huibo died in the fighting.

sentences.zh: 九月，侍中元子思與其弟子華謀西入，並賜死。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Palace Attendant Yuan Zisi and his nephew Zihua plotted to enter west and were both granted death.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Palace Attendant Yuan Zisi and his nephew Zihua plotted to enter west and were both granted death.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙丑，衛將軍、右光祿大夫蔣天樂謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on yichou, Guard General and Court Gentleman of the Luminous Office Jiang Tianle plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on yichou day Guard General and Court Gentleman of the Luminous Office Jiang Tianle plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 禁京師酤酒。

translations.literal: Selling wine in the capital was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Selling wine in the capital was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，以咸陽王坦為錄尚書事。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Prince of Xianyang Tan was made Recorder of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Prince of Xianyang Tan was made Recorder of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，勃海王高歡西討，敗於沙苑。
