translations.literal: On renchen, Prince of Bohai Gao Huan campaigned west and was defeated at Shayuan.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Prince of Bohai Gao Huan campaigned west and was defeated at Shayuan.

sentences.zh: 己酉，西魏行臺宮景壽、都督楊白駒寇洛州，大都督韓賢大破之。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Western Wei Mobile Secretariat Gong Yanshou and Area Commander Yang Baiju raided Luo Province; Grand Commander Han Xian inflicted a great defeat on them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Western Wei Mobile Secretariat Gong Yanshou and Area Commander Yang Baiju raided Luo Province; Grand Commander Han Xian inflicted a great defeat on them.

sentences.zh: 西魏又遣其大行臺元季海、大都督獨孤信逼洛州，刺史廣陽王湛棄城歸闕，季海、信遂據金墉。

translations.literal: Western Wei again sent its Grand Mobile Secretariat Yuan Jihai and Grand Area Commander Dugu Xin to press Luo Province; Regional Inspector and Prince of Guangyang Zhan abandoned the city and returned to court; Jihai and Xin then seized Jinyong.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei again sent its Grand Mobile Secretariat Yuan Jihai and Grand Area Commander Dugu Xin to press Luo Province; Regional Inspector and Prince of Guangyang Zhan abandoned the city and returned to court; Jihai and Xin then seized Jinyong.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙子，以驃騎大將軍、儀同三司万俟普為太尉。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Wan Qipu, General of Agile Cavalry and Commissioner Equal to the Third Rank, was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Wan Qipu, General of Agile Cavalry and Commissioner Equal to the Third Rank, was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲寅，梁人來聘。

translations.literal: On jiayin in the twelfth month, people of Liang came on a mission.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the twelfth month people of Liang came on a mission.

sentences.zh: 河間人邢磨納、范陽人盧仲禮等各聚眾反。

translations.literal: Xing Monai of Hejian and Lu Zhongli of Fanyang each gathered crowds in revolt.
translations.idiomatic: Xing Monai of Hejian and Lu Zhongli of Fanyang each gathered crowds in revolt.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、蠕蠕並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Goguryeo and Rouran both sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Goguryeo and Rouran both sent envoys to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 元象元年春正月辛酉朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the first month of spring of the first year of Yuanxiang, xinyou, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, the first day of the first month of spring of the first year of Yuanxiang, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 有巨象自至碭郡陂中，南兗州獲送於鄴。

translations.literal: A great elephant came of itself to a marsh in Dang Commandery; Southern Yanzhou captured it and sent it to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: A great elephant came of itself to a marsh in Dang Commandery; Southern Yanzhou captured it and sent it to Ye.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On dingmao a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰，遣兼散騎常侍鄭伯猷聘於梁。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Acting Palace Attendant Zheng Boyou was sent as envoy to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day Acting Palace Attendant Zheng Boyou was sent as envoy to Liang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚寅，曲赦畿內，開酒禁。

translations.literal: On gengyin in the fourth month of summer the metropolitan circuit was specially pardoned and the wine prohibition was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the fourth month of summer the metropolitan circuit was specially pardoned and the wine prohibition was lifted.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰，帝幸華林都堂，聽訟。

translations.literal: On renchen in the sixth month the Emperor visited the Hualin Assembly Hall and heard lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the sixth month the Emperor visited the Hualin Assembly Hall and heard lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 是夏，山東大水，蝦蟆鳴於樹上。

translations.literal: That summer east of the mountains there was great flood; frogs croaked in the trees.
translations.idiomatic: That summer east of the mountains there was great flood; frogs croaked in the trees.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙亥，高麗遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On yihai in the seventh month of autumn Goguryeo sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the seventh month of autumn Goguryeo sent envoys to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月辛卯，大敗西魏於河陰。

translations.literal: On xinmao in the eighth month Western Wei was greatly defeated at Heyin.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao in the eighth month Western Wei was greatly defeated at Heyin.

sentences.zh: 九月，大都督賀拔仁擊邢磨納、盧仲禮等破平之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Grand Commander Heba Ren attacked Xing Monai, Lu Zhongli, and others, defeated them, and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Grand Commander Heba Ren attacked Xing Monai, Lu Zhongli, and others, defeated them, and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，梁人來聘。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter people of Liang came on a mission.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter people of Liang came on a mission.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，遣陸操聘於梁。

translations.literal: On gengyin in the twelfth month Lu Cao was sent as envoy to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the twelfth month Lu Cao was sent as envoy to Liang.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月壬申，以太保尉景為太傅，以驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司厙狄幹為太保。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, on renshen, Grand Guardian Wei Jing was made Grand Tutor; Kudi Gan, General of Agile Cavalry and Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the second year, on renshen day Grand Guardian Wei Jing was made Grand Tutor; Kudi Gan, General of Agile Cavalry and Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，庫御新宮，大赦。

translations.literal: On dingchou the new palace was completed and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the new palace was completed and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 內外百官普進一階，營構主將別優一階。

translations.literal: Officials within and without were universally advanced one rank; chief builders received an additional preferential rank.
translations.idiomatic: Officials within and without were universally advanced one rank; chief builders received an additional preferential rank.

sentences.zh: 三月乙卯，梁人來聘。

translations.literal: On yimao people of Liang came on a mission.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day people of Liang came on a mission.

sentences.zh: 夏五月己酉，西魏行臺宮延和、陜州剌史宮元慶率戶內屬，置之河北馬場，振廩各有差。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Western Wei Mobile Secretariat Gong Yanhe and Shan Regional Inspector Gong Yuanqing led households to submit inward; they were placed on horse pastures in Hebei and given relief grain, each according to measure.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Western Wei Mobile Secretariat Gong Yanhe and Shan Regional Inspector Gong Yuanqing led households to submit inward; they were placed on horse pastures in Hebei and given relief grain, each according to measure.

sentences.zh: 壬子，遣兼散騎常侍李象聘於梁。

translations.literal: On renzi, Acting Palace Attendant Li Xiang was sent as envoy to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Acting Palace Attendant Li Xiang was sent as envoy to Liang.

sentences.zh: 閏月丁丑朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the intercalary month, dingchou, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou, the first day of the intercalary month, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 己丑，封皇兄景植為宜陽王，皇弟威為清河王。

translations.literal: On jichou, imperial elder brother Jingzhi was enfeoffed as Prince of Yiyang; imperial younger brother Wei as Prince of Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day imperial elder brother Jingzhi was enfeoffed as Prince of Yiyang; imperial younger brother Wei as Prince of Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 謙為潁川王。

translations.literal: Qian as Prince of Yingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Qian as Prince of Yingchuan.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，大司馬、華山王鷙薨。

translations.literal: On renzi, Grand Marshal and Prince of Huashan Zhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Grand Marshal and Prince of Huashan Zhi died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁未，梁人來聘。

translations.literal: On dingwei in the tenth month of winter people of Liang came on a mission.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the tenth month of winter people of Liang came on a mission.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙卯，遣兼散騎常侍崔長謙聘於梁。

translations.literal: On yimao in the twelfth month, Acting Palace Attendant Cui Changqian was sent as envoy to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the twelfth month Acting Palace Attendant Cui Changqian was sent as envoy to Liang.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、蠕蠕、勿吉並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Goguryeo, Rouran, and Wuji all sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Goguryeo, Rouran, and Wuji all sent envoys to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春二月甲辰，阿至羅出吐拔那渾大率部來降。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring of the third year, on jiachen, the Azhiluo led the Tuba Nahun tribe in great numbers to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring of the third year, on jiachen day the Azhiluo led the Tuba Nahun tribe in great numbers to submit.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，梁州人公孫貴賓聚眾反，自號天王，陽夏鎮將討禽之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on yiyou, Gongsun Guibin of Liang Province gathered a crowd in revolt, styled himself Heavenly King; the Yangxia Garrison general campaigned and captured him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yiyou day Gongsun Guibin of Liang Province gathered a crowd in revolt, styled himself Heavenly King; the Yangxia Garrison general campaigned and captured him.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊申，阿至羅國主副伏羅越君子去賓來降，封為高車王。

translations.literal: On wushen in the fourth month of summer, Fufoluoyue, vice-lord of the Azhiluo state, and the Yuezhi prince Qu Bin came to submit; Qu Bin was enfeoffed as King of Gaoche.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the fourth month of summer Fufoluoyue, vice-lord of the Azhiluo state, and the Yuezhi prince Qu Bin came to submit; Qu Bin was enfeoffed as King of Gaoche.

sentences.zh: 六月乙丑，梁人來聘。

translations.literal: On yichou in the sixth month people of Liang came on a mission.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the sixth month people of Liang came on a mission.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己卯，宜陽王景植薨。

translations.literal: On jimao in the seventh month of autumn Prince of Yiyang Jingzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the seventh month of autumn Prince of Yiyang Jingzhi died.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，遣兼散騎常侍李騫聘於梁。

translations.literal: On jiazi in the eighth month, Acting Palace Attendant Li Qian was sent as envoy to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the eighth month Acting Palace Attendant Li Qian was sent as envoy to Liang.

sentences.zh: 先是，詔群官於麟趾閣；

translations.literal: Earlier an edict had ordered the officials to assemble at the Linqiu Pavilion;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier an edict had ordered the officials to assemble at the Linqiu Pavilion;

sentences.zh: 議定新制，冬十月甲寅，班於天下。

translations.literal: to deliberate and fix the new regulations; in the tenth month of winter, on jiayin, they were promulgated throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: to deliberate and fix the new regulations; in the tenth month of winter, on jiayin day they were promulgated throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 己巳，發夫五萬人築漳濱堰，三十五日罷。

translations.literal: On jisi, fifty thousand laborers were mobilized to build the Zhangbin dam; work ceased after thirty-five days.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day fifty thousand laborers were mobilized to build the Zhangbin dam; work ceased after thirty-five days.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，車駕狩於西山。

translations.literal: On guihai the imperial carriage hunted in the western hills.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the imperial carriage hunted in the western hills.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊寅，還宮。

translations.literal: On wuyin in the eleventh month he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the eleventh month he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以開府儀同三司、彭城王韶為太尉，以度支尚書胡僧敬為司空。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Prince of Pengcheng Shao, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Grand Commandant; Hu Sengjing, Director of Revenue, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Prince of Pengcheng Shao, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Grand Commandant; Hu Sengjing, Director of Revenue, was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 是歲，蠕蠕、高麗、勿吉國並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Rouran, Goguryeo, and the Wuji state all sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Rouran, Goguryeo, and the Wuji state all sent envoys to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 武定元年春正月壬戌朔，大赦，改元。

translations.literal: On the first day of the first month of spring of the first year of Wuding, renxu, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, the first day of the first month of spring of the first year of Wuding, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

sentences.zh: 己巳，車駕搜於邯鄲之西山。

translations.literal: On jisi the imperial carriage hunted in the western hills of Handan.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the imperial carriage hunted in the western hills of Handan.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，還宮。

translations.literal: On guiyou he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 二月壬申，北豫州刺史高仲密據武牢西叛。

translations.literal: In the second month, on renshen, Gao Zhongmi, Northern Yu Regional Inspector, held Wulao and rebelled west.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renshen day Gao Zhongmi, Northern Yu Regional Inspector, held Wulao and rebelled west.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午，帝親納訟。

translations.literal: On bingwu in the third month the Emperor personally heard lawsuits.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the third month the Emperor personally heard lawsuits.

sentences.zh: 戊申，勃海王高歡大敗西魏師於邙山，追奔至恒農而還。

translations.literal: On wushen, Prince of Bohai Gao Huan inflicted a great defeat on the Western Wei army at Mount Mang and pursued to Hengnong before returning.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day Prince of Bohai Gao Huan inflicted a great defeat on the Western Wei army at Mount Mang and pursued to Hengnong before returning.

sentences.zh: 豫、洛二州平。

translations.literal: Yu and Luo—two provinces—were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Yu and Luo—two provinces—were pacified.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，封彭城王韶弟襲為武安王。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, younger brother Xi of Prince of Pengcheng Shao was enfeoffed as Prince of Wu'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer younger brother Xi of Prince of Pengcheng Shao was enfeoffed as Prince of Wu'an.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，以克復武牢，降天下死罪已下囚。

translations.literal: On renchen, because Wulao had been recovered, capital prisoners and below throughout the realm were pardoned to lower degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day because Wulao had been recovered capital prisoners and below throughout the realm were pardoned to lower degrees.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以吏部尚書侯景為司空。

translations.literal: On yiwei, Director of the Ministry of Personnel Hou Jing was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day Director of the Ministry of Personnel Hou Jing was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，梁人來聘。

translations.literal: On yihai in the sixth month people of Liang came on a mission.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the sixth month people of Liang came on a mission.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，封前員外散騎侍郎元長春為南郡王。

translations.literal: On wuyin, former Acting Palace Attendant Yuan Changchun was enfeoffed as Prince of Nan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day former Acting Palace Attendant Yuan Changchun was enfeoffed as Prince of Nan.

sentences.zh: 八月乙丑，以汾州刺史斛律金為大司馬。

translations.literal: On yichou, Hulu Jin, Regional Inspector of Fen, was made Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Hulu Jin, Regional Inspector of Fen, was made Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 壬午，遣兼散騎常侍李渾聘於梁。

translations.literal: On renyang, Acting Palace Attendant Li Hun was sent as envoy to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On renyang day Acting Palace Attendant Li Hun was sent as envoy to Liang.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月甲午，車駕狩於西山。

translations.literal: On jiawu in the eleventh month of winter the imperial carriage hunted in the western hills.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the eleventh month of winter the imperial carriage hunted in the western hills.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，還宮。

translations.literal: On yisi he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 是歲，吐谷渾、高麗、蠕蠕並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Tuyuhun, Goguryeo, and Rouran all sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tuyuhun, Goguryeo, and Rouran all sent envoys to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年春二月丁卯，徐州人劉烏黑聚眾反，遣行臺慕容紹宗討平之。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring of the second year, on dingmao, Liu Wuhei of Xuzhou gathered a crowd in revolt; Mobile Secretariat Murong Shaozong was sent to campaign and pacify him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring of the second year, on dingmao day Liu Wuhei of Xuzhou gathered a crowd in revolt; Mobile Secretariat Murong Shaozong was sent to campaign and pacify him.

sentences.zh: 三月，梁人來聘。

translations.literal: In the third month people of Liang came on a mission.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month people of Liang came on a mission.

sentences.zh: 以旱故，宥死罪已下囚。

translations.literal: Because of drought, capital prisoners and below were pardoned to lower degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Because of drought capital prisoners and below were pardoned to lower degrees.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以開府儀同三司孫騰為太保。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Sun Teng, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Sun Teng, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以勃海王世子高澄為大將軍，領中書監。

translations.literal: On renzi, heir of Prince of Bohai Gao Cheng was made Grand General and Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day heir of Prince of Bohai Gao Cheng was made Grand General and Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 元弼為錄尚書事。

translations.literal: Yuan Bi was made Recorder of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Bi was made Recorder of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 以尚書左僕射司馬子如為尚書令。

translations.literal: Left Vice Director Sima Ziru was made Director of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Left Vice Director Sima Ziru was made Director of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 以太原公高洋為左僕射。

translations.literal: Duke of Taiyuan Gao Yang was made Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Taiyuan Gao Yang was made Left Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 夏五月甲午，遣散騎常侍魏季景聘於梁。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Palace Attendant Wei Jijing was sent as envoy to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Palace Attendant Wei Jijing was sent as envoy to Liang.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，太尉、廣陽王湛薨。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Grand Commandant and Prince of Guangyang Zhan died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Grand Commandant and Prince of Guangyang Zhan died.

sentences.zh: 秋八月癸酉，尚書令司馬子如坐事免。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Director of the Department of State Affairs Sima Ziru was dismissed for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day Director of the Department of State Affairs Sima Ziru was dismissed for an offense.

sentences.zh: 九月甲申，以開府儀同三司、濟陰王暉業為太尉。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Prince of Jiyin Huiye, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Prince of Jiyin Huiye, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 太師、咸陽王坦坐事免，以王還第。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor and Prince of Xianyang Tan was dismissed for an offense and returned to his residence as prince.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Preceptor and Prince of Xianyang Tan was dismissed for an offense and returned to his residence as prince.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳，太保孫騰、大司馬高隆之各為括戶大使，凡獲逃戶六十餘萬。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Grand Guardian Sun Teng and Grand Marshal Gao Longzhi were each made commissioners for registering households; in all more than six hundred thousand fugitive households were obtained.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Grand Guardian Sun Teng and Grand Marshal Gao Longzhi were each made commissioners for registering households; in all more than six hundred thousand fugitive households were obtained.

sentences.zh: 十一月，西河地陷，有火出。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month the land sank in Xihe and fire issued forth.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the land sank in Xihe and fire issued forth.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以司徒高隆之為尚書令，以前大司馬婁昭為司徒。

translations.literal: On jiashen, Gao Longzhi, Minister over the Masses, was made Director of the Department of State Affairs; former Grand Marshal Lou Zhao was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day Gao Longzhi, Minister over the Masses, was made Director of the Department of State Affairs; former Grand Marshal Lou Zhao was made Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 庚子，祀圓丘。

translations.literal: On gengzi sacrifice was offered at the Circular Mound.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day sacrifice was offered at the Circular Mound.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，梁人來聘。

translations.literal: On xinchou people of Liang came on a mission.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day people of Liang came on a mission.

sentences.zh: 是歲，吐谷渾、地豆幹、室韋、高麗、蠕蠕、勿吉等並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Tuyuhun, Didougan, Xianbei, Goguryeo, Rouran, and Wuji all sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tuyuhun, Didougan, Xianbei, Goguryeo, Rouran, and Wuji all sent envoys to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丙申，遣兼散騎常侍李獎聘於梁。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the third year, on bingshen, Acting Palace Attendant Li Jiang was sent as envoy to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring of the third year, on bingshen day Acting Palace Attendant Li Jiang was sent as envoy to Liang.

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，吐谷渾國奉其從妹以備後庭，納為容華嬪。

translations.literal: On gengshen in the second month, the Tuyuhun state presented its younger cousin by the female line to fill the rear palace; she was received as Ronghua Consort.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the second month the Tuyuhun state presented its younger cousin by the female line to fill the rear palace; she was received as Ronghua Consort.

sentences.zh: 夏五月甲辰，大赦。

translations.literal: On jiachen in the fifth month of summer a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the fifth month of summer a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚子，梁人來聘。

translations.literal: On gengzi in the seventh month of autumn people of Liang came on a mission.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the seventh month of autumn people of Liang came on a mission.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，遣中書舍人尉瑾聘於梁。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Secretariat Gentleman Wei Jin was sent as envoy to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter Secretariat Gentleman Wei Jin was sent as envoy to Liang.

sentences.zh: 十二月，以司空侯景為司徒，以中書令韓軌為司空。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Hou Jing, Minister of Works, was made Minister over the Masses; Han Gui, Director of the Secretariat, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Hou Jing, Minister of Works, was made Minister over the Masses; Han Gui, Director of the Secretariat, was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以太保孫騰為錄尚書事。

translations.literal: On wuzi, Grand Guardian Sun Teng was made Recorder of the Department of State Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Grand Guardian Sun Teng was made Recorder of the Department of State Affairs.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、吐谷渾、蠕蠕並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Goguryeo, Tuyuhun, and Rouran all sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Goguryeo, Tuyuhun, and Rouran all sent envoys to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 四年夏五月壬寅，梁人來聘。

translations.literal: On renyin in the fifth month of summer of the fourth year people of Liang came on a mission.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the fifth month of summer of the fourth year people of Liang came on a mission.

sentences.zh: 六月庚子，以司徒侯景為河南大行臺，應機討防。

translations.literal: On gengzi in the sixth month, Hou Jing, Minister over the Masses, was made Grand Ambassador of Henan and was to campaign as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi in the sixth month Hou Jing, Minister over the Masses, was made Grand Ambassador of Henan and was to campaign as circumstances required.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，遣兼散騎常侍元廓聘於梁。

translations.literal: On renyin in the seventh month of autumn, Acting Palace Attendant Yuan Kuo was sent as envoy to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the seventh month of autumn Acting Palace Attendant Yuan Kuo was sent as envoy to Liang.

sentences.zh: 八月，移洛陽漢魏石經於鄴。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the Han and Wei stone classics of Luoyang were moved to Ye.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the Han and Wei stone classics of Luoyang were moved to Ye.

sentences.zh: 是歲，室韋、勿吉、地豆幹、高麗、蠕蠕並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Xianbei, Wuji, Didougan, Goguryeo, and Rouran all sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Xianbei, Wuji, Didougan, Goguryeo, and Rouran all sent envoys to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月己亥朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On jihai, the first day of the first month of spring of the fifth year, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, the first day of the first month of spring of the fifth year, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 丙午，勃海王高歡薨。

translations.literal: On bingwu, Prince of Bohai Gao Huan died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day Prince of Bohai Gao Huan died.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，司徒侯景降於西魏以求救。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Minister over the Masses Hou Jing surrendered to Western Wei to seek rescue.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day Minister over the Masses Hou Jing surrendered to Western Wei to seek rescue.

sentences.zh: 西魏遣其將李弼、王思政赴之。

translations.literal: Western Wei sent its generals Li Bi and Wang Sizheng to go to his aid.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei sent its generals Li Bi and Wang Sizheng to go to his aid.

sentences.zh: 思政等入據潁川，景乃出走豫州。

translations.literal: Sizheng and others entered and seized Yingchuan; Jing then fled to Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: Sizheng and others entered and seized Yingchuan; Jing then fled to Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，梁人來聘。

translations.literal: On yichou people of Liang came on a mission.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day people of Liang came on a mission.

sentences.zh: 二月，侯景復背西魏歸梁。

translations.literal: In the second month Hou Jing again turned against Western Wei and returned to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Hou Jing again turned against Western Wei and returned to Liang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申，大將軍高澄來朝。

translations.literal: On renshen in the fourth month of summer, Grand General Gao Cheng came to court.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the fourth month of summer Grand General Gao Cheng came to court.

sentences.zh: 甲午，遣兼散騎常侍李緯聘於梁。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Acting Palace Attendant Li Wei was sent as envoy to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day Acting Palace Attendant Li Wei was sent as envoy to Liang.

sentences.zh: 五月丁酉朔，大赦。

translations.literal: On the first day of the fifth month, dingyou, a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the first day of the fifth month, a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以尚書右僕射、襄城王旭為太尉。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Right Vice Director and Prince of Xiangcheng Xu was made Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Right Vice Director and Prince of Xiangcheng Xu was made Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以太原公高洋為尚書令，領中書監。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Duke of Taiyuan Gao Yang was made Director of the Department of State Affairs and Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day Duke of Taiyuan Gao Yang was made Director of the Department of State Affairs and Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 以青州刺史尉景為大司馬。

translations.literal: Wei Jing, Regional Inspector of Qing, was made Grand Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Jing, Regional Inspector of Qing, was made Grand Marshal.

sentences.zh: 以開府儀同三司庫狄幹為太師。

translations.literal: Kudi Gan, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: Kudi Gan, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 以錄尚書事孫騰為太傅。

translations.literal: Sun Teng, Recorder of the Department of State Affairs, was made Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Teng, Recorder of the Department of State Affairs, was made Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 以汾州刺史賀拔仁為太保。

translations.literal: Heba Ren, Regional Inspector of Fen, was made Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: Heba Ren, Regional Inspector of Fen, was made Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 以司空韓軌為司徒。

translations.literal: Han Gui, Minister of Works, was made Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: Han Gui, Minister of Works, was made Minister over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 以領軍將軍可朱渾道元為司空。

translations.literal: Kezhuhun Daoyuan, Commandant of the Guard, was made Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Kezhuhun Daoyuan, Commandant of the Guard, was made Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 以司徒高隆之錄尚書事，以徐州刺史慕容紹宗為尚書左僕射，高陽王斌為右僕射。

translations.literal: Gao Longzhi, Minister over the Masses, was made Recorder of the Department of State Affairs; Murong Shaozong, Regional Inspector of Xuzhou, was made Left Vice Director; Prince of Gaoyang Bin was made Right Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Longzhi, Minister over the Masses, was made Recorder of the Department of State Affairs; Murong Shaozong, Regional Inspector of Xuzhou, was made Left Vice Director; Prince of Gaoyang Bin was made Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 戊午，大司馬尉景薨。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Grand Marshal Wei Jing died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Grand Marshal Wei Jing died.

sentences.zh: 六月乙酉，帝為勃海王舉哀於東堂，服緦衰。

translations.literal: On yiyou in the sixth month the Emperor observed mourning for Prince of Bohai at the Eastern Hall, wearing coarse hemp.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the sixth month the Emperor observed mourning for Prince of Bohai at the Eastern Hall, wearing coarse hemp.

sentences.zh: 秋九月辛丑，梁貞陽侯蕭明寇徐州，堰泗水於寒山，灌彭城，以應侯景。

translations.literal: On xinchou in the ninth month of autumn, Marquis of Zhenyang Xiao Ming of Liang raided Xuzhou, dammed the Si River at Han Mountain, flooded Pengcheng, and responded to Hou Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the ninth month of autumn Marquis of Zhenyang Xiao Ming of Liang raided Xuzhou, dammed the Si River at Han Mountain, flooded Pengcheng, and responded to Hou Jing.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月乙酉，以尚書左僕射慕容紹宗為東南道行臺，與大都督高嶽、潘相樂大破禽之，及其二子瑀道。

translations.literal: On yiyou in the eleventh month, Left Vice Director Murong Shaozong was made Southeastern Circuit Mobile Secretariat; together with Grand Commander Gao Yue and Pan Xiangle he inflicted a great defeat and captured Ming and his two sons Yudao.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the eleventh month Left Vice Director Murong Shaozong was made Southeastern Circuit Mobile Secretariat; together with Grand Commander Gao Yue and Pan Xiangle he inflicted a great defeat and captured Ming and his two sons Yudao.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙亥，蕭明至，帝御閶闔門，讓而宥之。

translations.literal: On yihai, when Xiao Ming arrived the Emperor came to the Gate of Opening the Gate to All Directions, reproached him, and pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day when Xiao Ming arrived the Emperor came to the Gate of Opening the Gate to All Directions, reproached him, and pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 嶽等回師討侯景。

translations.literal: Yue and others turned their army to campaign against Hou Jing.
translations.idiomatic: Yue and others turned their army to campaign against Hou Jing.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗、勿吉並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Goguryeo and Wuji both sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Goguryeo and Wuji both sent envoys to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月己亥，大都督高嶽等於渦陽大破侯景。

translations.literal: On jihai in the first month of spring of the sixth year, Gao Yue and others at Woyang inflicted a great defeat on Hou Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the first month of spring of the sixth year Gao Yue and others at Woyang inflicted a great defeat on Hou Jing.

sentences.zh: 俘斬五萬餘人，其餘溺死於渦水，水為不流。

translations.literal: More than fifty thousand were captured and beheaded; the rest drowned in the Wo River until the water did not flow.
translations.idiomatic: More than fifty thousand were captured and beheaded; the rest drowned in the Wo River until the water did not flow.

sentences.zh: 景走淮南。

translations.literal: Jing fled to Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: Jing fled to Huainan.

sentences.zh: 二月己卯。

translations.literal: On jimao in the second month.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the second month.

sentences.zh: 梁遣使求和。

translations.literal: Liang sent envoys seeking peace.
translations.idiomatic: Liang sent envoys seeking peace.

sentences.zh: 許之。

translations.literal: Peace was granted.
translations.idiomatic: Peace was granted.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，以太尉、襄城王旭為大司馬，以開府儀同三司高嶽為太尉。

translations.literal: On guisi in the third month, Grand Marshal and Prince of Xiangcheng Xu was made Grand Marshal; Gao Yue, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi in the third month Grand Marshal and Prince of Xiangcheng Xu was made Grand Marshal; Gao Yue, Commissioner with Opening Office Equal to the Third Rank, was made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以冬春亢旱，赦罪人各有差。

translations.literal: On xinhai, because of drought in spring and winter, criminals were pardoned to varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day because of drought in spring and winter criminals were pardoned to varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，吏部令史張永和、青州人崔闊等偽假人官，事覺糾檢，首者六萬餘人。

translations.literal: On jiazi in the fourth month of summer, Zhang Yonghe, clerical officer of the Ministry of Personnel, and Cui Kuo of Qing Province and others falsely forged official posts; the affair was discovered and investigated; leaders numbered more than sixty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi in the fourth month of summer Zhang Yonghe, clerical officer of the Ministry of Personnel, and Cui Kuo of Qing Province and others falsely forged official posts; the affair was discovered and investigated; leaders numbered more than sixty thousand.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，太尉高嶽、司徒韓軌、大都督劉豐等討王思政於潁川，引洧水灌其城。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Grand Commandant Gao Yue, Minister over the Masses Han Gui, Grand Commander Liu Feng, and others campaigned against Wang Sizheng at Yingchuan and led the Wei River to flood the city.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Grand Commandant Gao Yue, Minister over the Masses Han Gui, Grand Commander Liu Feng, and others campaigned against Wang Sizheng at Yingchuan and led the Wei River to flood the city.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，梁人來聘。

translations.literal: On yiyou in the ninth month people of Liang came on a mission.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the ninth month people of Liang came on a mission.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊申，侯景濟江，推梁臨賀王正德為主，以攻建業。

translations.literal: On wushen in the tenth month of winter Hou Jing crossed the Yangtze, installed Liang Prince of Linhe Zhengde as ruler, and attacked Jianye.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen in the tenth month of winter Hou Jing crossed the Yangtze, installed Liang Prince of Linhe Zhengde as ruler, and attacked Jianye.

sentences.zh: 是歲，高麗，室韋、蠕蠕、吐谷渾並遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Goguryeo, Xianbei, Rouran, and Tuyuhun all sent envoys to pay tribute.
translations.idiomatic: That year Goguryeo, Xianbei, Rouran, and Tuyuhun all sent envoys to pay tribute.

sentences.zh: 二年十二月己酉，中山王殂，時年二十八。

translations.literal: On jiyou in the twelfth month of the second year Prince of Zhongshan died, aged twenty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the twelfth month of the second year Prince of Zhongshan died, aged twenty-eight.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，奉謚曰孝靜皇帝。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year he was posthumously honored as Emperor Xiaojing.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year he was posthumously honored as Emperor Xiaojing.

sentences.zh: 葬於鄴西漳北。

translations.literal: He was buried north of the Zhang west of Ye.
translations.idiomatic: He was buried north of the Zhang west of Ye.

sentences.zh: 其後發之，陵崩，死者六十人。

translations.literal: Later when the tomb was opened the mound collapsed and sixty men died.
translations.idiomatic: Later when the tomb was opened the mound collapsed and sixty men died.

sentences.zh: 帝好文，美容儀。

translations.literal: The Emperor was fond of literature and had a beautiful bearing.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was fond of literature and had a beautiful bearing.

sentences.zh: 力能挾石師子以逾墻，射無不中。

translations.literal: His strength could lift a stone lion over a wall; in archery he never missed.
translations.idiomatic: His strength could lift a stone lion over a wall; in archery he never missed.

sentences.zh: 嘉辰宴會，多命群臣賦詩。

translations.literal: At auspicious feasts he often ordered the ministers to compose poems.
translations.idiomatic: At auspicious feasts he often ordered the ministers to compose poems.

sentences.zh: 從容沈雅，有孝文風。

translations.literal: Composed and dignified in manner, he had the manner of Emperor Xiaowen.
translations.idiomatic: Composed and dignified in manner, he had the manner of Emperor Xiaowen.

sentences.zh: 勃海王高澄嗣事，甚忌焉。

translations.literal: Gao Cheng of Bohai succeeded to affairs and was very jealous of him.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Cheng of Bohai succeeded to affairs and was very jealous of him.

sentences.zh: 以大將軍中兵參軍崔季舒為中書、黃門侍郎，令監察動靜，小大皆令季舒知。

translations.literal: Cui Jishu, staff officer of the Grand General Center Army, was made Attendant of the Secretariat and Attendant at the Yellow Gate and ordered to monitor movements; great and small were all to be known to Jishu.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Jishu, staff officer of the Grand General Center Army, was made Attendant of the Secretariat and Attendant at the Yellow Gate and ordered to monitor movements; great and small were all to be known to Jishu.

sentences.zh: 澄與季舒書曰：「癡人復何似？

translations.literal: Cheng wrote to Jishu: "How is the fool again?
translations.idiomatic: Cheng wrote to Jishu: "How is the fool again?

sentences.zh: 癡勢小差未？

translations.literal: Is the fool's condition a little better?"
translations.idiomatic: Is the fool's condition a little better?"

sentences.zh: 」帝嘗與獵於鄴東，馳逐如飛。

translations.literal: Once when hunting east of Ye the Emperor galloped in pursuit like flight.
translations.idiomatic: Once when hunting east of Ye the Emperor galloped in pursuit like flight.

sentences.zh: 監衛都督烏那羅受工伐從後呼帝曰：「天子莫走馬，大將軍怒！

translations.literal: Supervisory Guard Commander Wunaluo Shougong called after him from behind: "Son of Heaven, do not run your horse—the Grand General will be angry!"
translations.idiomatic: Supervisory Guard Commander Wunaluo Shougong called after him from behind: "Son of Heaven, do not run your horse—the Grand General will be angry!"

sentences.zh: 」澄嘗侍帝飲，大舉觴曰：「臣澄勸陛下。

translations.literal: Once when Cheng attended the Emperor drinking he raised his cup greatly and said: "Your servant Cheng urges Your Majesty."
translations.idiomatic: Once when Cheng attended the Emperor drinking he raised his cup greatly and said: "Your servant Cheng urges Your Majesty."

sentences.zh: 」帝不悅曰：「自古無不亡之國，朕亦何用此活！

translations.literal: The Emperor said displeased: "From antiquity there has been no state that did not perish—what use have I for this life!"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said displeased: "From antiquity there has been no state that did not perish—what use have I for this life!"

sentences.zh: 」澄怒曰：「朕，朕，狗腳朕！

translations.literal: Cheng said angrily: "I, I—dog-foot I!"
translations.idiomatic: Cheng said angrily: "I, I—dog-foot I!"

sentences.zh: 」澄使季舒毆帝三拳，奮衣而出。

translations.literal: Cheng had Jishu beat the Emperor three blows with fists, snatched up his robe, and went out.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng had Jishu beat the Emperor three blows with fists, snatched up his robe, and went out.

sentences.zh: 明日，澄，使季舒勞帝，帝亦謝焉。

translations.literal: The next day Cheng had Jishu comfort the Emperor, and the Emperor also apologized.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Cheng had Jishu comfort the Emperor, and the Emperor also apologized.

sentences.zh: 賜絹，季舒未敢受，以啟澄。

translations.literal: Silk was bestowed; Jishu did not dare accept and reported to Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: Silk was bestowed; Jishu did not dare accept and reported to Cheng.

sentences.zh: 澄使取一段。

translations.literal: Cheng had one length taken.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng had one length taken.

sentences.zh: 帝束百疋以與之，曰：「亦一段爾。」

translations.literal: The Emperor bound one hundred bolts and gave them to him, saying: "Also only one length."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor bound one hundred bolts and gave them to him, saying: "Also only one length."

sentences.zh: 帝不堪憂辱，詠謝靈運詩曰：「韓亡子房奮，秦帝魯連恥。

translations.literal: Unable to bear worry and insult, the Emperor chanted a poem of Xie Lingyun: "When Han perished Zifang rose up; when Qin had an emperor Lu Lian was shamed. Originally men of river and sea, their resolve and righteousness moved gentlemen."
translations.idiomatic: Unable to bear worry and insult, the Emperor chanted a poem of Xie Lingyun: "When Han perished Zifang rose up; when Qin had an emperor Lu Lian was shamed. Originally men of river and sea, their resolve and righteousness moved gentlemen."

sentences.zh: 本自江海人，誌義動君子。

translations.literal: Regular Attendant and Lecturer Xun Ji knew the Emperor's intent;
translations.idiomatic: Regular Attendant and Lecturer Xun Ji knew the Emperor's intent;

sentences.zh: 」常侍、侍講荀濟知帝意，乃與華山王大器、元瑾密謀於宮中。

translations.literal: he with Prince of Huashan Daqi and Yuan Jin secretly plotted within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: he with Prince of Huashan Daqi and Yuan Jin secretly plotted within the palace.

sentences.zh: 偽為山而作地道向北城。

translations.literal: Feigning a mountain they dug a tunnel north toward the northern city.
translations.idiomatic: Feigning a mountain they dug a tunnel north toward the northern city.

sentences.zh: 至千秋門，門者覺地下響動，以告澄。

translations.literal: At the Gate of a Thousand Autumns the gatekeepers perceived underground sound and movement and reported to Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: At the Gate of a Thousand Autumns the gatekeepers perceived underground sound and movement and reported to Cheng.

sentences.zh: 澄勒兵入營，曰：「陛下何意反耶？

translations.literal: Cheng led troops into camp and said: "Your Majesty—what intent is this rebellion? My father and I, our merit preserves the altars of soil and grain—what have we failed Your Majesty in?"
translations.idiomatic: Cheng led troops into camp and said: "Your Majesty—what intent is this rebellion? My father and I, our merit preserves the altars of soil and grain—what have we failed Your Majesty in?"

sentences.zh: 臣父子功存社稷，何負陛下耶？

translations.literal: When he was about to kill the consorts and concubines,
translations.idiomatic: When he was about to kill the consorts and concubines,

sentences.zh: 」及將殺諸妃嬪。

translations.literal: the Emperor said with stern countenance: "You yourself wish to rebel—what has it to do with me?
translations.idiomatic: the Emperor said with stern countenance: "You yourself wish to rebel—what has it to do with me?

sentences.zh: 帝正色曰：「王自欲反，何關於我？

translations.literal: I do not spare even my own person—how much less consorts and concubines!"
translations.idiomatic: I do not spare even my own person—how much less consorts and concubines!

sentences.zh: 我尚不惜身，何況妃嬪！

translations.literal: Cheng descended from the couch, kowtowed, and wept greatly in confession of guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng descended from the couch, kowtowed, and wept greatly in confession of guilt.

sentences.zh: 」澄下床叩頭，大啼，謝罪。

translations.literal: Thereupon they drank heavily and only went out deep in the night.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon they drank heavily and only went out deep in the night.

sentences.zh: 於是酣飲，夜久乃出。

translations.literal: After three days the Emperor was confined in the Hall of Containing Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: After three days the Emperor was confined in the Hall of Containing Splendor.

sentences.zh: 居三日，幽帝於含章堂。

translations.literal: Daqi, Jin, and others were all boiled in the market.
translations.idiomatic: Daqi, Jin, and others were all boiled in the market.

sentences.zh: 大器、瑾等皆見烹於市。

translations.literal: Daqi, Jin, and the others were all boiled alive in the market.
translations.idiomatic: Daqi, Jin, and the others were all executed by boiling in the market.

sentences.zh: 及將禪位於文宣，襄城王昶及司徒潘相樂、侍中張亮、黃門郎趙彥深等求入奏事。

translations.literal: When he was about to yield the throne to Emperor Wenxuan, Prince of Xiangcheng Chang and Minister over the Masses Pan Xiangle, Palace Attendant Zhang Liang, Attendant at the Yellow Gate Zhao Yanshen, and others requested audience to report affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When he was about to yield the throne to Emperor Wenxuan, Prince of Xiangcheng Chang, Minister over the Masses Pan Xiangle, Palace Attendant Zhang Liang, Attendant at the Yellow Gate Zhao Yanshen, and others requested audience to report affairs.

sentences.zh: 帝在昭陽殿見之。

translations.literal: Xu said: "The Five Phases pass in succession; there is beginning and end.
translations.idiomatic: Xu said: "The Five Phases pass in succession; there is beginning and end.

sentences.zh: 旭曰：「五行遞運，有始有終。

translations.literal: The Prince of Qi is sage in virtue and bright; the myriad people look up to him.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Qi is sage in virtue and bright; the myriad people look up to him.

sentences.zh: 齊王聖德欽明，萬姓歸仰。

translations.literal: We, your servants, risk death to report and beg Your Majesty to yield as Yao yielded to Shun."
translations.idiomatic: We, your servants, risk death to report and beg Your Majesty to yield as Yao yielded to Shun."

sentences.zh: 臣等昧死聞奏，願陛下則堯禪舜。

translations.literal: The Emperor immediately composed his countenance and answered: "This matter has long been deferred; I shall respectfully yield and withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor immediately composed his countenance and answered: "This matter has long been deferred; I shall respectfully yield and withdraw.

sentences.zh: 」帝便斂容答曰：「此事推挹已久，謹當遜避。

translations.literal: He also said: "If so, an edict must be drafted."
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "If so, an edict must be drafted."

sentences.zh: 」又云：「若爾，須作詔書。

translations.literal: Attendant Gentleman Cui Jie and Pei Rangzhi memorialized: "The edict is already complete."
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Gentleman Cui Jie and Pei Rangzhi memorialized: "The edict is already complete."

sentences.zh: 」侍郎崔劼、裴讓之奏云：「詔已作訖。

translations.literal: It was at once given to Yang Yin to present to the Emperor—ten articles in all.
translations.idiomatic: It was at once given to Yang Yin to present to the Emperor—ten articles in all.

sentences.zh: 」即付楊愔進於帝，凡十條。

translations.literal: When the writing was finished he said: "Where will you place me? How again shall I depart?"
translations.idiomatic: When the writing was finished he said: "Where will you place me? How again shall I depart?"

sentences.zh: 書訖，曰：「將安朕何所？

translations.literal: Yang Yin answered: "In the northern city there is a separate residence; the imperial equipage will again be prepared; you will go as usual with guards and escort."
translations.idiomatic: Yang Yin answered: "In the northern city there is a separate residence; the imperial equipage will again be prepared; you will go as usual with guards and escort."

sentences.zh: 復若為而去？

translations.literal: The Emperor then descended from the imperial seat and walked to the eastern corridor.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor then descended from the imperial seat and walked to the eastern corridor.

sentences.zh: 」楊愔對曰：「在北城，別有館宇，還備法駕，依常仗衛而去。

translations.literal: He chanted orally Fan Ye's Account of the Latter Han: "The Offered Emperor was born out of season; his person was cast amid national hardship; ending our four hundred years, forever to be guest of Yu."
translations.idiomatic: He chanted orally from Fan Ye's Account of the Latter Han: "The Offered Emperor was born out of season; his person was cast amid national hardship; ending our four hundred years, forever to be guest of Yu."

sentences.zh: 」帝乃下御座，步就東廊。

translations.literal: The authorities memorialized requesting departure.
translations.idiomatic: The authorities memorialized requesting departure.

sentences.zh: 口詠範蔚宗《後漢書贊》云：「獻生不辰，身播國屯，終我四百，永作虞賓。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "The ancients cherished a lost hairpin or worn shoes; may I take leave of the six palaces—is it possible?"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "The ancients cherished a lost hairpin or worn shoes; may I take leave of the six palaces—is it possible?"

sentences.zh: 」所司奏請發。

translations.literal: Gao Longzhi said: "Today the realm is still Your Majesty's realm—how much more the rear palace!"
translations.idiomatic: Gao Longzhi said: "Today the realm is still Your Majesty's realm—how much more the rear palace!"

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「古人念遺簪弊履，欲與六宮別，可乎？

translations.literal: Thereupon he took leave of the ladies, consorts, and those below; none did not sob and cover their faces.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon he took leave of the ladies, consorts, and those below; none did not sob and cover their faces.

sentences.zh: 」高隆之曰：「今天下猶陛下之天下，況在後宮！

translations.literal: Consort Li of Zhao recited a poem of Prince Si of Chen: "My lord, cherish your jade body and together enjoy the years of yellow hair."
translations.idiomatic: Consort Li of Zhao recited a poem of Prince Si of Chen: "My lord, cherish your jade body and together enjoy the years of yellow hair."

sentences.zh: 」乃與夫人嬪以下訣，莫不欷歔掩涕。

translations.literal: From the Empress downward all wept.
translations.idiomatic: From the Empress downward all wept.

sentences.zh: 嬪趙國李氏誦陳思王詩云：「王其愛玉體，俱享黃髮期。

translations.literal: Direct Attendant Zhao De had one old calf cart waiting at the upper gate of the eastern tower.
translations.idiomatic: Direct Attendant Zhao De had one old calf cart waiting at the upper gate of the eastern tower.

sentences.zh: 」皇后已下皆哭。

translations.literal: The Emperor mounted the cart; De leaped up onto the cart and held the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor mounted the cart; De leaped up onto the cart and held the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 直長趙德以故犢車一乘，候於東上閣。

translations.literal: The Emperor elbowed him and said: "I fear Heaven and follow the people, yielding the throne to the Chancellor—what slave dares press a man!"
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor elbowed him and said: "I fear Heaven and follow the people, yielding the throne to the Chancellor—what slave dares press a man!"

sentences.zh: 帝上車，德超上車，持帝。

translations.literal: Zhao De still would not descend.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao De still would not descend.

sentences.zh: 帝肘之，曰：「朕畏天順人，授位相國，何物奴，敢逼人！

translations.literal: When they went out through the Cloud Dragon Gate, dukes, princes, and the hundred officials in caps and robes bowed in farewell.
translations.idiomatic: When they went out through the Cloud Dragon Gate dukes, princes, and the hundred officials in caps and robes bowed in farewell.

sentences.zh: 」趙德尚不下。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Today is no less than Duke of Changdao or Emperor Xian of Han."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said: "Today is no less than Duke of Changdao or Emperor Xian of Han."

sentences.zh: 及出雲龍門，王公百僚衣冠拜辭。

translations.literal: The masses were all grief-stricken; Gao Longzhi wept profusely.
translations.idiomatic: The masses were all grief-stricken; Gao Longzhi wept profusely.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「今日不減常道鄉公、漢獻帝。

translations.literal: He then entered the northern city and went down to Sima Ziru's southern residence.
translations.idiomatic: He then entered the northern city and went down to Sima Ziru's southern residence.

sentences.zh: 」眾皆悲愴，高隆之泣灑。

translations.literal: The masses were all grief-stricken; Gao Longzhi wept profusely.
translations.idiomatic: The masses were all grief-stricken; Gao Longzhi wept profusely.

sentences.zh: 遂入北城，下司馬子如南宅。

translations.literal: He then entered the northern city and went down to Sima Ziru's southern residence.
translations.idiomatic: He then entered the northern city and went down to Sima Ziru's southern residence.

sentences.zh: 及文宣行幸，常以帝自隨。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wenxuan traveled he always had the Emperor follow.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Wenxuan traveled he always had the Emperor follow.

sentences.zh: 帝后封太原公主，常為帝嘗食，以護視焉。

translations.literal: The Emperor's consort was enfeoffed as Princess of Taiyuan; she often tasted food for the Emperor to guard and watch over him.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor's consort was enfeoffed as Princess of Taiyuan; she often tasted food for the Emperor to guard and watch over him.

sentences.zh: 竟遇鴆而崩。

translations.literal: In the end he met poison and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the end he met poison and died.

sentences.zh: 論曰：莊帝運接交喪，招納勤王。

translations.literal: Commentary says: Emperor Zhuang's fate met successive loss; he welcomed and gathered loyal armies.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary says: Emperor Zhuang's fate met successive loss; he welcomed and gathered loyal armies.

sentences.zh: 雖時事孔棘，而卒有四海。

translations.literal: Though the times were desperately perilous, in the end he held the four seas.
translations.idiomatic: Though the times were desperately perilous, in the end he held the four seas.

sentences.zh: 猾逆剪除，權強擅命，神慮獨斷，芒刺未除；

translations.literal: Crafty rebels were cut down; powerful men monopolized commands; the divine will decided alone—yet thorns were not yet removed;
translations.idiomatic: Crafty rebels were cut down; powerful men monopolized commands; the divine will decided alone—yet thorns were not yet removed;

sentences.zh: 而天未忘亂，禍不旋踵。

translations.literal: and Heaven had not forgotten disorder; disaster did not turn its heel.
translations.idiomatic: and Heaven had not forgotten disorder; disaster did not turn its heel.

sentences.zh: 自茲之後，魏室土崩。

translations.literal: From this onward the house of Wei crumbled.
translations.idiomatic: From this onward the house of Wei crumbled.

sentences.zh: 始則制屈強胡，終乃權歸霸政。

translations.literal: At first they restrained the strong barbarians; in the end power returned to the hegemonic ministers.
translations.idiomatic: At first they restrained the strong barbarians; in the end power returned to the hegemonic ministers.

sentences.zh: 主祭祀者不殊於寄坐，遇黜辱者有甚於弈棋。

translations.literal: Those who presided over sacrifice were no different from seated guests; those who met deposition and insult were worse than in a game of chess.
translations.idiomatic: Those who presided over sacrifice were no different from seated guests; those who met deposition and insult were worse than in a game of chess.

sentences.zh: 雖以節閔之明，孝武之長，祗以速是奔波。

translations.literal: Though Jiemin was bright and Xiaowu was long in years, they only hastened this rushing about.
translations.idiomatic: Though Jiemin was bright and Xiaowu was long in years, they only hastened this rushing about.

sentences.zh: 文帝以剛強之質，終以守雌自寶。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen with his strong, firm substance in the end kept to the female and treasured himself.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen with his strong, firm substance in the end kept to the female and treasured himself.

sentences.zh: 靜、恭運終天祿，高蹈唐、虞，各得其時也。

translations.literal: Xiaojing and Gong, when Heaven's mandate ended, ascended high and followed Tang and Yu—each obtained his season.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaojing and Gong, when Heaven's mandate ended, ascended high and followed Tang and Yu—each obtained his season.
